records.original_source_text:
जटाकटाहसम्भ्रमभ्रमन्निलिम्पनिर्झरी-विलोलवीचिवल्लरीविराजमानमूर्धनि ।
धगद्धगद्धगज्ज्वलल्ललाटपट्टपावके किशोरचन्द्रशेखरे रतिः प्रतिक्षणं मम ॥ २ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: May my constant devotion abide in Lord Shiva, upon whose head shines the celestial river Ganges with waving spray rippling within the cauldron of His matted locks, whose forehead blazes with the leaping flame 'dhagad-dhagad-dhagad', and who is crowned by the crescent moon.

records.original_source_text:
धराधरेन्द्रनन्दिनीविलासबन्धुबन्धुर-स्फुरद्दिगन्तसन्ततिप्रमोदमानमानसे ।
कृपाकटाक्षधोरणीनिरुद्धदुर्धरापदि क्वचिद्दिगम्बरे मनो विनोदमेतु वस्तुनि ॥ ३ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: May my mind find bliss in that omnipresent Lord who wears space as His garment, whose mind rejoices in the playful glances of Parvati (daughter of the King of Mountains), and whose continuous cascades of compassionate glances dispel the most insurmountable adversities.

records.original_source_text:
जटाभुजङ्गपिङ्गलस्फुरत्फणामणिप्रभा-कदम्बकुङ्कुमद्रवप्रलिप्तदिग्वधूमुखे ।
मदान्धसिन्धुरस्फुरत्त्वगुत्तरीयमेदुरे मनो विनोदमद्भुतं बिभर्तु भूतभर्तरि ॥ ४ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: May my mind find wondrous delight in the Sustainer of all living beings, whose serried snakes with reddish hoods shed gem-radiance smearing the faces of the quarters like liquid saffron, and whose thick upper garment is fashioned from the skin of the intoxicated elephant.

records.original_source_text:
सहस्रलोचनप्रभृत्यशेषलेखशेखर-प्रसूनधूलिधोरणीविधूसराङ्घ्रिपीठभूः ।
भुजङ्गराजमालया निबद्धजाटजूटकः श्रियै चिराय जायतां चकोरबन्धुशेखरः ॥ ५ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: May that Lord whose footstool is made grey by the dense pollen falling from the garlanded diadems of all gods including thousand-eyed Indra, whose matted locks are bound by the serpent king, and who wears the moon (kin of the chakora bird) as his crest, bestow enduring auspiciousness upon us.

records.original_source_text:
ललाटचत्वरज्वलद्धनञ्जयस्फुलिङ्गभा-निपीतपञ्चसायकं नमन्निलिम्पनायकम् ।
सुधामयूखलेखया विराजमानशेखरं महाकपालिसम्पदे शिरोजटालमस्तु नः ॥ ६ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: May the matted hair of that Great Bearer of the Skull yield spiritual wealth unto us—He who consumed Kamadeva (the god with five arrows) in the sparks of the fire blazing upon the courtyard of His forehead, who is bowed down to by the rulers of the gods, and whose head is adorned by the streak of the nectar-beamed moon.

records.original_source_text:
करालभालपट्टिकाधगद्धगद्धगज्ज्वल-द्धनञ्जयाहुतीकृतप्रचण्डपञ्चसायके ।
धराधरेन्द्रनन्दिनीकुचाग्रचित्रपत्रक-प्रकल्पनैकशिल्पिनि त्रिलोचने रतिर्मम ॥ ७ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: May my constant devotion be in the Three-Eyed Lord, who offered the fierce god of love as an oblation into the blazing fire flashing 'dhagad-dhagad-dhagad' across His terrible forehead, and who is the sole artist drawing decorative designs upon the bosom of Parvati, daughter of the mountain king.

records.original_source_text:
नवीनमेघमण्डलीनिरुद्धदुर्धरस्फुरत्-कुहूनिशीथिनीतमःप्रबन्धबद्धकन्धरः ।
निलिम्पनिर्झरीधरस्तनोतु कृत्तिसिन्धुरः कलानिधानबन्धुरः श्रियं जगद्धुरन्धरः ॥ ८ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: May that Bearer of the burden of the universe grant prosperity unto us—He whose throat has the deep darkness of a new moon midnight veiled by fresh rain-clouds, who holds the celestial river, wears elephant hide, and is adorned by the moon, the repository of all divine arts.

records.original_source_text:
प्रफुल्लनीलपङ्कजप्रपञ्चकालिमप्रभा-वलम्बिकण्ठकन्दलीरुचिप्रबद्धकन्धरम् ।
स्मरच्छिदं पुरच्छिदं भवच्छिदं मखच्छिदं गजच्छिदान्धकच्छिदं तमन्तकच्छिदं भजे ॥ ९ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: I worship Him who severed the pride of Kama, destroyed the Three Cities of Tripura, broke worldly bondage, destroyed Daksha's sacrifice, slew the demon Gajasura and Andhaka, and conquered the God of Death (Yama)—He whose throat reflects the lustrous blackness of an open blue lotus.

records.original_source_text:
अखर्वसर्वमङ्गलाकलामन्दमञ्जरी-रसप्रवाहमाधुरीविजृम्भणामधुव्रतम् ।
स्मरान्तकं पुरान्तकं भवान्तकं मखान्तकं गजान्तकान्धकान्तकं तमन्तकान्तकं भजे ॥ १० ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: I worship Him who ended Kama, destroyed Tripura, destroyed cycle of birth, ended the ego of Daksha, slew Gajasura, ended Andhaka, and conquered Death—He who is the honey-bee drinking the expanding nectar-stream flowing from the blossoming cluster of all auspicious arts.

records.original_source_text:
जयत्वदभ्रविभ्रमभ्रमद्भुजङ्गमश्वस-द्विनिर्गमत्क्रमस्फुरत्करालभालहव्यवाट् ।
धिमिद्धिमिद्धिमिध्वनन्मृदङ्गतुङ्गमङ्गल-ध्वनिक्रमप्रवर्तितप्रचण्डताण्डवः शिवः ॥ ११ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Victory to Shiva! In whose forehead blazes the terrible sacrificial fire fueled by the hissed breath of the wildly whirling serpents, and whose impassioned cosmic Tandava dance proceeds in unison with the solemn, auspicious rhythm of the mridanga beating 'dhimid-dhimid-dhimid'!

records.original_source_text:
दृषद्विचित्रतल्पयोर्भुजङ्गमौक्तिकस्रजोर्-गरिष्ठरत्नलोष्ठयोः सुहृद्विपक्षपक्षयोः ।
तृणारविन्दचक्षुषोः प्रजामहीमहेन्द्रयोः समं प्रवर्तयन्मनः कदा सदाशिवं भजे ॥ १२ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: When will I worship Sadashiva with an equanimous mind that sees no difference between a hard stone and a splendid bed, a serpent and a pearl garland, a precious gem and a lump of clay, a friend and an enemy, a blade of grass and a lotus eye, or a common subject and a mighty emperor?

records.original_source_text:
कदा निलिम्पनिर्झरीनिकेतनोत्तरे वसन् विमुक्तदुर्मतिः सदा शिरःस्थमञ्जलिं वहन् ।
विमुक्तलोललोचनो ललामभाललग्नकः शिवेति मन्त्रमुच्चरन् कदा सुखी भवाम्यहम् ॥ १३ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: When shall I dwell on the holy banks of the celestial river Ganges, rid of all wicked thoughts, holding my folded hands over my head, free from wandering desires, meditating on the Lord with the brilliant forehead, uttering the sacred mantra 'Shiva', and abide in supreme bliss?

records.original_source_text:
इमं हि नित्यमेवमुक्तमुत्तमोत्तमं स्तवं पठन्स्मरन्ब्रुवन्नरो विशुद्धिमेति सन्ततम् ।
हरे गुरौ सुभक्तिमाशु याति नान्यथा गतिं विमोहनं हि देहिनां सुशङ्करस्य चिन्तनम् ॥ १४ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Whoever daily recites, remembers, and chants this peerless supreme hymn attains perpetual inner purity. He swiftly gains deep devotion to Lord Shiva, the supreme Guru; for there is no other refuge, and contemplation upon the auspicious Lord dissolves all worldly delusion.

records.original_source_text:
पूजावसानसमये दशवक्त्रगीतं यः शम्भुपूजनपरं पठति प्रदोषे ।
तस्य स्थिरां रथगजेन्द्रतुरङ्गयुक्तां लक्ष्मीं सदैव सुमुखीं प्रददाति शम्भुः ॥ १५ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Whoever, after completing Shiva's worship, recites at dusk (Pradosha) this hymn sung by the Ten-Headed Ravana, to him Lord Shambhu grants enduring prosperity endowed with chariots, noble elephants, and horses, accompanied by the gracious favor of Lakshmi forever.

records.original_source_text:
इति श्रीरावणकृतं शिवताण्डवस्तोत्रं सम्पूर्णम् ।
ॐ नमः शिवाय ॥ १६ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Thus concludes the Shiva Tandava Stotram composed by Ravana. Om Namah Shivaya.

records.original_source_text: ततो युद्धपरिश्रान्तं समरे चिन्तया स्थितम् । रावणं चाग्रतो दृष्ट्वा युद्धाय समुपस्थितम् ॥ १ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Then, beholding Sri Rama standing exhausted on the battlefield, absorbed in deep contemplation, and seeing Ravana nearby duly prepared for combat...
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: दैवतैश्च समागम्य द्रष्टुमभ्यागतो रणम् । उपगम्याब्रवीद्राममगस्त्यो भगवानृषिः ॥ २ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: ...the revered Sage Agastya, who had joined the assemblage of gods to witness the battle, approached Rama and spoke as follows:
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: राम राम महाबाहो शृणु गुह्यं सनातनम् । येन सर्वानरीन् वत्स समरे विजयिष्यसे ॥ ३ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'O Rama! O mighty-armed Rama! Listen to this eternal secret, by which, my child, you shall conquer all your adversaries on the battlefield.'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: आदित्यहृदयं पुण्यं सर्वशत्रुविनाशनम् । जयावहं जपेन्नित्यमक्षयं परमं शिवम् ॥ ४ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'This holy hymn, Aditya Hrudayam, destroys all foes, brings victory, and should be recited constantly; it is inexhaustible, supreme, and all-auspicious.'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: सर्वमङ्गलमाङ्गल्यं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् । चिन्ताशोकप्रशमनमायुर्वर्धनमुत्तमम् ॥ ५ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'It is the blessing of all blessings, dispeller of all sins, allayer of anxieties and grief, and the supreme enhancer of longevity.'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: रश्मिमन्तं समुद्यन्तं देवासुरनमस्कृतम् । पूजयस्व विवस्वन्तं भास्करं भुवनेश्वरम् ॥ ६ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'Worship the effulgent Lord of the universe, the Sun, endowed with golden rays, rising gloriously, adored by both gods and demons, the maker of light.'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: सर्वदेवात्मको ह्येष तेजस्वी रश्मिभावनः । एष देवासुरगणांल्लोकान् पाति गभस्तिभिः ॥ ७ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'He is the soul of all gods, full of splendor, creator of the rays; He protects the realms of gods, demons, and all beings by His penetrating rays.'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: एष ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च शिवः स्कन्दः प्रजापतिः । महेन्द्रो धनदः कालो यमः सोमो ह्यपां पतिः ॥ ८ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'He is Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva, Skanda, Prajapati; He is Indra, Kubera (lord of wealth), Kala (time), Yama, Soma (moon), and Varuna (lord of waters).'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: पितरो वसवः साध्या ह्यश्विनौ मरुतो मनुः । वायुर्वह्निः प्रजाप्राण ऋतुकर्ता प्रभाकरः ॥ ९ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'He is the Pitris, Vasus, Sadhyas, the Ashvins, Maruts, Manu; He is Vayu, Agni, the vital breath of all creatures, creator of the seasons, and the source of light.'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: आदित्यः सविता सूर्यः खगः पूषा गभस्तिमान् । सुवर्णसदृशो भानुर्हिरण्यरेता दिवाकरः ॥ १० ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'He is Aditya, Savita (procreator), Surya (mover), Khaga (sky-traveler), Pusha (nourisher), Gabhastiman (radiant), golden in beauty, Hiranyareta (golden seed), maker of day.'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: हरिदश्वः सहस्रार्चिः सप्तसप्तिर्मरीचिमान् । तिमिरोन्मथनः शम्भुस्त्वष्टा मार्तण्ड अंशुमान् ॥ ११ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'He has emerald steeds, thousand rays, seven horses, brilliant beams; dispeller of darkness, Shambhu (giver of happiness), Tvashta (shaper), Martanda, effulgent One.'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: हिरण्यगर्भः शिशिरस्तपनो भास्करो रविः । अग्निगर्भोऽदितेः पुत्रः शङ्खः शिशिरनाशनः ॥ १२ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'He is Hiranyagarbha, cool soothing light, heat-giver, maker of light, Ravi; Agni-wombed, son of Aditi, soothing like a conch, dispeller of winter cold.'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: व्योमनाथस्तमोभेदी ऋग्यजुःसामपारगः । घनवृष्टिरपां मित्रो विन्ध्यवीथीप्लवङ्गमः ॥ १३ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'Lord of the firmament, piercer of darkness, master of Rig, Yajur, and Sama Vedas; bringer of rain, friend of waters, gliding across the Vindhya pathway.'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: आतपी मण्डली मृत्युः पिङ्गलः सर्वतापनः । कविर्विश्वो महातेजा रक्तः सर्वभवोद्भवः ॥ १४ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'Creator of heat, circular orb, death (to darkness), tawny One, all-scorcher; omniscient seer, cosmic form, exceedingly brilliant, reddish, source of all existence.'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: नक्षत्रग्रहताराणामधिपो विश्वभावनः । तेजसामपि तेजस्वी द्वादशात्मन् नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ १५ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'Ruler of lunar constellations, planets, and stars; generator of the universe; most brilliant of all lustres; O Twelve-souled Sun, salutations unto You!'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: नमः पूर्वाय गिरये पश्चिमायाद्रये नमः । ज्योतिर्गणानां पतये दिनाधिपतये नमः ॥ १६ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'Salutations to the eastern mount of sunrise, salutations to the western mount of sunset; salutations to the Lord of stellar hosts and the Sovereign of the day!'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: जयाय जयभद्राय हर्यश्वाय नमो नमः । नमो नमः सहस्रांशो आदित्याय नमो नमः ॥ १७ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'Salutations to the Victorious One, giver of auspicious triumph! Salutations to Him of green steeds! Salutations to the Thousand-Rayed Aditya!'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: नम उग्राय वीराय सारङ्गाय नमो नमः । नमः पद्मप्रबोधाय मार्ताण्डाय नमो नमः ॥ १८ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'Salutations to the Terrible One, the Valiant One, the Swift Traveler! Salutations to the Awakener of lotuses, the glorious Martanda!'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: ब्रह्मेशानाच्युतेशाय सूर्यायादित्यवर्चसे । भास्वते सर्वभक्षाय रौद्राय वपुषे नमः ॥ १९ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'Lord of Brahma, Shiva, and Achyuta; Surya possessing Aditya's luster; luminous One, consumer of all things, embodiment of Rudra, salutations!'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: तमोघ्नाय हिमघ्नाय शत्रुघ्नायामितात्मने । कृतघ्नघ्नाय देवाय ज्योतिषां पतये नमः ॥ २० ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'Destroyer of darkness, dispeller of frost, slayer of enemies, immeasurable Soul; destroyer of the ungrateful, divine Lord of lights, salutations!'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: तप्तचामीकराभाय वह्नये विश्वकर्मणे । नमस्तमोऽभिनिघ्नाय रुचये लोकसाक्षिणे ॥ २१ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'Radiant like molten gold, fiery form, maker of all things; salutations to the vanquisher of gloom, the effulgent Witness of the worlds!'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: नाशयत्येष वै भूतं तदेव सृजति प्रभुः । पायत्येष तपत्येष वर्षत्येष गभस्तिभिः ॥ २२ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'This Sovereign Lord dissolves all created beings and recreates them anew; with His rays He absorbs water, He generates heat, and He pours forth rain.'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: एष सुप्तेषु जागर्ति भूतेषु परिनिष्ठितः । एष एवाग्निहोत्रं च फलं चैवाग्निहोत्रिणाम् ॥ २३ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'He remains awake within sleeping beings, dwelling in all hearts; He is the Agnihotra sacrifice itself and the ultimate fruit of the sacrificers.'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: वेदाश्च क्रतवश्चैव क्रतूनां फलमेव च । यानि कृत्यानि लोकेषु सर्व एष रविः प्रभुः ॥ २४ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'The Vedas, the rituals, and the rewards of all sacrifices, and whatsoever actions occur across worlds—all are Lord Ravi alone.'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: एनमापत्सु कृच्छ्रेषु कान्तारेषु भयेषु च । कीर्तयन् पुरुषः कश्चिन्नावसीदति राघव ॥ २५ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'O Raghava! Any man who recites this hymn in perils, severe distress, wildernesses, or fearful situations shall never succumb to despair.'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: पूजयस्वैनमेकाग्रो देवदेवं जगत्पतिम् । एतत् त्रिगुणितं जप्त्वा युद्धेषु विजयिष्यसे ॥ २६ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'Worship with single-pointed devotion this God of gods, Sovereign of the universe. Reciting this thrice, you shall attain victory in battles!'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: अस्मिन् क्षणे महाबाहो रावणं त्वं वधिष्यसि । एवमुक्त्वा तदागस्त्यो जगाम च यथागतम् ॥ २७ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: ''In this very hour, O mighty-armed hero, you shall slay Ravana!' Having thus spoken, Sage Agastya departed as he had come.'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: एतच्छ्रुत्वा महातेजा नष्टशोकोऽभवत्तदा । धारयामास सुप्रीतो राघवः प्रयतात्मवान् ॥ २८ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'Hearing this, the immensely resplendent Raghava was instantly freed from sorrow; highly pleased, he held this sacred hymn firmly in his purified mind.'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: आदित्यं प्रेक्ष्य जप्त्वा तु परं हर्षमवाप्तवान् । त्रिराचम्य शुचिर्भूत्वा धनुरादाय वीर्यवान् ॥ २९ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'Gazing upon the Sun and reciting the hymn, He experienced supreme joy; sipping water thrice (Achamana), purified, the valiant Rama seized His bow.'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: रावणं प्रेक्ष्य हृष्टात्मा युद्धाय समुपागमत् । सर्वयत्नेन महता वधे तस्य धृतोऽभवत् ॥ ३० ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'Beholding Ravana with high spirits, Rama stepped forward to battle; with all his formidable prowess, he became resolute upon his destruction.'
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text: अथ रविरवदन्निरीक्ष्य रामं मुदितमनाः परमं प्रहृष्यमाणः । निशिचरपतिसंक्षयं विदित्वा सुरगणमध्यगतो वचस्त्वरेति ॥ ३१ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'Then the Sun god, gazing down upon Rama with a joyful heart and supreme delight, knowing the imminent demise of the King of Night-Stalkers, spoke from amidst the assembly of gods: 'Make haste!''
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Maharishi Valmiki / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text:
अधरं मधुरं वदनं मधुरं नयनं मधुरं हसितं मधुरम् ।
हृदयं मधुरं गमनं मधुरं मधुराधिपतेरखिलं मधुरम् ॥ १ ॥

records.original_source_text:

records.existing_bhavartha: His lips are sweet, His face is sweet, His eyes are sweet, His gentle smile is sweet; His heart is sweet, His graceful gait is sweet—everything pertaining to the Lord of Sweetness is utterly sweet.

records.existing_bhavartha: ஸ்ரீகிருஷ்ணரின் இதழ்கள் மதுரமானவை, திருமுகம் மதுரமானது, கண்கள் மதுரமானவை, புன்னகை மதுரமானது, இதயம் மதுரமானது, நடையும் மதுரமானது; மதுராதிபதியான ஸ்ரீகிருஷ்ணரின் எல்லாமே மதுரமானவை.

उ॒र्वा॒रु॒कमि॑व॒ बन्ध॑नान्मृ॒त्योर्मु॑क्षीय॒ माऽमृता॑त् ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: અમે સુગંધિત અને સમસ્ત જીવોનું પોષણ કરનારા ત્રિનેત્રધારી ભગવાન શિવની આરાધના કરીએ છીએ. પાકેલું ટેટી જેમ વેલાના બંધનમાંથી સહજ મુક્ત થાય છે, તેમ આપણે સંસાર અને મૃત્યુના ભયથી મુક્ત થઈ અમૃતત્વને પામીએ.
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Rigveda Samhita 7.59.12; Shukla Yajurveda Samhita 3.60
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Rishi Maitravaruni Vasishtha / Rishi Markandeya

records.existing_bhavartha: हम सुगंधित और भक्तों का पोषण करने वाले त्रिनेत्रधारी भगवान शिव की आराधना करते हैं। जिस प्रकार पका हुआ ककड़ी रूपी फल अपनी बेल के बंधन से मुक्त हो जाता है, उसी प्रकार हम मृत्यु के पाश से मुक्त हों, किंतु अमरता के अमृत से विमुख न हों।
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Rigveda Samhita 7.59.12; Shukla Yajurveda Samhita 3.60
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Rishi Maitravaruni Vasishtha / Rishi Markandeya

records.existing_bhavartha: ಸುಗಂಧಭರಿತನೂ, ಸಮಸ್ತ ಜೀವಿಗಳನ್ನು ಪೋಷಿಸುವವನೂ ಆದ ಮುಕ್ಕಣ್ಣ ಶಿವನನ್ನು ನಾವು ಭಕ್ತಿಯಿಂದ ಆರಾಧಿಸುತ್ತೇವೆ. ಬಲಿತ ಸೌತೆಕಾಯಿಯು ಬಳ್ಳಿಯಿಂದ ಮುಕ್ತವಾಗುವಂತೆ, ನಾವು ಮೃತ್ಯುವಿನ ಬಂಧನದಿಂದ ಮುಕ್ತರಾಗಿ ಅಮೃತತ್ವವನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯೋಣ.
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Rigveda Samhita 7.59.12; Shukla Yajurveda Samhita 3.60
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Rishi Maitravaruni Vasishtha / Rishi Markandeya

records.existing_bhavartha: സുഗന്ധമുള്ളവനും സമസ്ത പ്രാണികളെയും പരിപോഷിപ്പിക്കുന്നവനുമായ മുക്കണ്ണനായ പരമശിവനെ ഞങ്ങൾ ആരാധിക്കുന്നു. പഴുത്ത വെള്ളരിക്ക വള്ളിയിൽനിന്നും സ്വയം വേർപെടുന്നതുപോലെ, ഞങ്ങൾ മൃത്യുവിന്റെ പാശത്തിൽനിന്നും മോചിതരായി അമൃതത്വത്തിലേക്ക് എത്തപ്പെടുമാറാകട്ടെ.
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Rigveda Samhita 7.59.12; Shukla Yajurveda Samhita 3.60

records.existing_bhavartha: ଆମ୍ଭେ ସୁଗନ୍ଧିଯୁକ୍ତ ଓ ସମସ୍ତ ପ୍ରାଣୀଙ୍କର ପୁଷ୍ଟିବର୍ଦ୍ଧନକାରୀ ତ୍ରିନେତ୍ରଧାରୀ ଭଗବାନ ଶିବଙ୍କର ଆରାଧନା କରୁଛୁ । ପାଚିଲା କାକୁଡ଼ି ଯେପରି ଲତାର ବନ୍ଧନରୁ ସହଜରେ ମୁକ୍ତ ହୁଏ, ସେହିପରି ଆମ୍ଭେ ମୃତ୍ୟୁର ବନ୍ଧନରୁ ମୁକ୍ତ ହୋଇ ଅମୃତତ୍ୱ ଲାଭ କରୁ ।
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Rigveda Samhita 7.59.12; Shukla Yajurveda Samhita 3.60
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Rishi Maitravaruni Vasishtha / Rishi Markandeya

records.existing_bhavartha: நறுமணமிக்கவரும், அனைத்து உயிர்களையும் போஷிப்பவருமான முக்கண்ணனாம் சிவபெருமானை நாங்கள் வணங்குகிறோம். முதிர்ந்த வெள்ளரிப்பழம் காம்பிலிருந்து விடுபடுவது போல, நாங்கள் மரணத்தின் பிடியிலிருந்து விடுபட்டு அழியாப் பேரின்ப முக்தியை அடைவோமாக.

Attributed Composer/Rishi: Rishi Maitravaruni Vasishtha / Rishi Markandeya

तत्स॑वि॒तुर्वरे॑ण्यं॒ भर्गो॑ दे॒वस्य॑ धीमहि ।
धियो॒ यो नः॑ प्रचो॒दया॑त् ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: సమస్త లోకములను సృష్టించి ప్రకాశింపజేయు ఆ పరమ దివ్య సవితృ భగవానుని తేజస్సును మేము ధ్యానించుచున్నాము. ఆ పరమాత్ముడు మా బుద్ధులను సత్యమార్గమునందు ప్రేరేపించును గాక.
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Rigveda Samhita 3.62.10; Shukla Yajurveda Samhita 36.3

records.original_source_text:
हि॒र॒ण्यव॑र्णां॒ हरि॑णीं सु॒वर्ण॑रजत॒स्रजा॑म् ।
च॒न्द्रां हि॒रण्म॑यीं ल॒क्ष्मीं जात॑वेदो म॒ आव॑ह ॥ १ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: O Jatavedas (Agni)! Invoke for me that Lakshmi who shines with the golden hue, who is graceful like a deer, adorned with garlands of gold and silver, luminous like the cool moon, and of golden essence.
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Rishis Ananda, Chiklita, Kardama, Sri

records.original_source_text:
तां म॒ आव॑ह॒ जात॑वेदो ल॒क्ष्मीमन॑पगा॒मिनी॑म् ।
यस्यां॒ हिर॑ण्यं वि॒न्देयं॒ गामश्वं॒ पुरु॑षान॒हम् ॥ २ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: O Agni! Invoke for me that Lakshmi who will never depart from me, through whose presence I shall obtain gold, cattle, horses, and devoted kin.
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Rishis Ananda, Chiklita, Kardama, Sri

records.original_source_text:
अ॒श्व॒पूर्वां र॑थम॒ध्यां ह॒स्तिना॑दप्र॒बोधि॑नीम् ।
श्रियं॑ दे॒वीमुप॑ह्वये॒ श्रीर्मा॑ दे॒वीरुप॑स्पृशतु ॥ ३ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: I invoke that Goddess Sri, who is heralded by noble steeds, seated amidst glorious chariots, and awakened by the trumpeting of royal elephants. May the divine Goddess Sri touch me with Her grace!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Rishis Ananda, Chiklita, Kardama, Sri

records.original_source_text:
कां॒ सो᳚स्मि॒तां हिर॑ण्यप्रा॒कारा॑मा॒र्द्रां ज्वल॑न्तीं तृ॒प्तां त॒र्पय॑न्तीम् ।
प॒द्मे॒ स्थि॒तां प॒द्मव॑र्णां॒ तामि॒होप॑ह्वये॒ श्रिय॑म् ॥ ४ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: I invoke here that Goddess Sri, who has a radiant smile, who is enclosed in golden ramparts, ever moist with compassion, blazing with splendor, fully contented and bestowing fulfillment, seated on a lotus, and of lotus hue.
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Rishis Ananda, Chiklita, Kardama, Sri

records.original_source_text:
च॒न्द्रां प्र॑भा॒सां य॒शसा॒ ज्वल॑न्तीं॒ श्रियं॑ लो॒के दे॒वजु॑ष्टामुदा॒राम् ।
तां प॒द्मिनी॑मीं॒ शर॑णम॒हं प्रप॑द्येऽल॒क्ष्मीर्मे॑ नश्यतां॒ त्वां वृ॑णे ॥ ५ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: I seek refuge in that Goddess Sri, who shines like the radiant moon, blazing with glory, revered by the gods in all worlds, most magnanimous, who holds a lotus. May my misfortune (Alakshmi) be destroyed! I surrender unto You.
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Rishis Ananda, Chiklita, Kardama, Sri

records.original_source_text:
आ॒दि॒त्यव॑र्णे॒ तप॒सोऽधि॑जा॒तो वन॒स्पति॒स्तव॑ वृ॒क्षोऽथ बि॒ल्वः ।
तस्य॒ फला॑नि॒ तप॒सा नु॑दन्तु मा॒यान्त॑रा॒याश्च॑ बा॒ह्या अ॑ल॒क्ष्मीः ॥ ६ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: O Goddess radiant as the sun! Out of Your intense spiritual austerity was born the king of trees, the holy Bilva tree. May the fruits of that tree, through spiritual merit, dispel inner ignorance and outer poverty.
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Rishis Ananda, Chiklita, Kardama, Sri

records.original_source_text:
उपै॑तु॒ मां दे॑वस॒खः की॒र्तिश्च॒ मनि॑ना स॒ह ।
प्रा॒दु॒र्भू॒तोऽस्मि॑ राष्ट्रे॒ऽस्मिन् की॒र्तिमृ॑द्धिं द॒दातु॑ मे ॥ ७ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: May Kubera (friend of the gods) approach me along with Fame and the wish-fulfilling jewel! I am born into this land; may You grant me renown and prosperity!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Rishis Ananda, Chiklita, Kardama, Sri

records.original_source_text:
क्षुत्पि॑पा॒साम॑लां ज्ये॒ष्ठाम॑ल॒क्ष्मीं ना॑शया॒म्यहम् ।
अभू॑ति॒मसमृ॑द्धिं च॒ सर्वां॒ निर्णु॑द मे॒ गृहा॑त् ॥ ८ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: I drive away the elder Alakshmi, afflicted by hunger and thirst, impure and destitute. Banish all misfortune and scarcity from my dwelling!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Rishis Ananda, Chiklita, Kardama, Sri

records.original_source_text:
ग॒न्ध॒द्वा॒रां दु॑राध॒र्षां नि॒त्यपु॑ष्टां करी॒षिणी᳚म् ।
ई॒श्वरीं᳚ सर्व॑भूता॒नां तामि॒होप॑ह्वये॒ श्रिय॑म् ॥ ९ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: I invoke here that Goddess Sri, accessible through divine fragrance, invincible, ever bountiful, rich in agricultural abundance and cattle-wealth, the sovereign Ruler of all living beings.
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Rishis Ananda, Chiklita, Kardama, Sri

records.original_source_text:
मन॑सः॒ काम॒माकू॑तिं वा॒चः स॒त्यम॑शीमहि ।
प॒शू॒नां रू॒पमन्न॑स्य॒ मयि॒ श्रीः श्र॑यतां॒ यशः॑ ॥ १० ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: May we realize the noble desires and aspirations of our heart! May our speech be truthful! May the wealth of cattle, nourishment of grains, divine splendor, and holy fame abide in me!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Rishis Ananda, Chiklita, Kardama, Sri

records.original_source_text:
क॒र्दमे॑न प्र॑जाभू॒ता॒ मयि॒ सम्भ॑व क॒र्दम ।
श्रियं॑ वा॒सय॑ मे कु॒ले मा॒तरं॑ पद्म॒मालि॑नीम् ॥ ११ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: O Kardama! By your austerity, Goddess Sri became manifest as progeny. Reside in me, O Kardama, and establish your Mother, the lotus-garlanded Sri, in my lineage!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Rishis Ananda, Chiklita, Kardama, Sri

records.original_source_text:
आपः॑ सृ॒जन्तु॑ स्नि॒ग्धा॒नि॒ चि॒क्ली॒त व॑स मे॒ गृहे ।
नि च॑ दे॒वीं मा॒तरं॒ श्रियं॑ वा॒सय॑ मे कु॒ले ॥ १२ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: May the celestial waters produce affectionate abundance! O Chiklita, dwell in my home and firmly establish the divine Mother Sri in my ancestral family!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Rishis Ananda, Chiklita, Kardama, Sri

records.original_source_text:
आ॒र्द्रां पु॒ष्करि॑णीं पु॒ष्टिं पि॒ङ्ग॒लां प॑द्ममा॒लिनी᳚म् ।
च॒न्द्रां हि॒रण्म॑यीं ल॒क्ष्मीं जात॑वेदो म॒ आव॑ह ॥ १३ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: O Agni! Invoke for me that Lakshmi who is ever moist with tender grace, holding a lotus, embodiment of nourishment, golden-hued, garlanded with lotuses, radiant like the moon, and made of gold.
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Rishis Ananda, Chiklita, Kardama, Sri

records.original_source_text:
आ॒र्द्रां यः॒ करि॑णीं य॒ष्टिं सु॒व॒र्णां हे॑ममा॒लिनी᳚म् ।
सूर्यां॑ हि॒रण्म॑यीं ल॒क्ष्मीं जात॑वेदो म॒ आव॑ह ॥ १४ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: O Agni! Invoke for me that Lakshmi who holds the regal staff of power, beautiful in form, adorned with gold necklaces, effulgent like the sun, and golden in nature.
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Rishis Ananda, Chiklita, Kardama, Sri

records.original_source_text:
तां म॒ आव॑ह॒ जात॑वेदो ल॒क्ष्मीमन॑पगा॒मिनी॑म् ।
यस्यां॒ हिर॑ण्यं प्रभू॑तं॒ गावो॑ दा॒स्योऽश्वा᳚न् वि॒न्देयं॒ पुरु॑षान॒हम् ॥ १५ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: O Agni! Invoke for me that never-departing Lakshmi, through whom I shall obtain abundant gold, cows, attendants, noble steeds, and faithful kin.
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Rishis Ananda, Chiklita, Kardama, Sri

records.original_source_text:
यः शुचिः॑ प्रयोतो भू॒त्वा जु॑हुया॒दाज्य॑मन्व॒हम् ।
सूक्तं॑ पञ्चदश॒र्चं च॑ श्री॒कामः॑ सत॒तं ज॑पेत् ॥ १६ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Whoever, being pure in mind and self-restrained, offers oblation of ghee daily and constantly recites this fifteen-versed hymn (suktam pancadasarcam), desiring prosperity, attains enduring divine grace.
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Rishis Ananda, Chiklita, Kardama, Sri

records.original_source_text:
श्रीगुरु चरन सरोज रज निज मनु मुकुरु सुधारि ।
बरनउँ रघुबर बिमल जसु जो दायकु फल चारि ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Cleansing the mirror of my mind with the dust of the holy lotus feet of my Guru, I narrate the pure renown of Lord Raghuvira (Sri Rama), which bestows the four fruits of human existence (Dharma, Artha, Kama, Moksha).

records.original_source_text:
बुद्धिहीन तनु जानिके सुमिरौ पवन-कुमार ।
बल बुधि बिद्या देहु मोहिं हरहु कलेस बिकार ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Knowing myself to be devoid of wisdom, I contemplate You, O Son of the Wind! Bestow upon me strength, intellect, and spiritual knowledge, and dispel all my afflictions and inner blemishes.

records.original_source_text: जय हनुमान ज्ञान गुन सागर । जय कपीस तिहुँ लोक उजागर ॥ १ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Hail, Hanuman, ocean of wisdom and virtues! Hail, lord among monkeys, illuminator of the three worlds!

records.original_source_text: राम दूत अतुलित बल धामा । अञ्जनि-पुत्र पवनसुत नामा ॥ २ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Messenger of Rama, abode of incomparable strength, son of Anjani, known as the Son of the Wind.

records.original_source_text: महाबीर बिक्रम बजरङ्गी । कुमति निवार सुमति के सङ्गी ॥ ३ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Valiant hero of thunderbolt limbs, dispeller of evil thoughts, companion of the wise.

records.original_source_text: कञ्चन बरन बिराज सुबेसा । कानन कुण्डल कुञ्चित केसा ॥ ४ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: With golden complexion and splendid attire, with sparkling earrings and curly locks.

records.original_source_text: हाथ बज्र औ ध्वजा बिराजै । काँधे मूँज जनेऊ साजै ॥ ५ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: In Your hands gleam the thunderbolt and flag, upon Your shoulder rests the sacred munja grass thread.

records.original_source_text: सङ्कर सुवन केसरीनन्दन । तेज प्रताप महा जग बन्दन ॥ ६ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Incarnation of Shiva, son of Kesari, Your blazing glory is revered throughout the universe.

records.original_source_text: बिद्यावान गुनी अति चातुर । राम काज करिबे को आतुर ॥ ७ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Learned, virtuous, profoundly wise, always eager to accomplish Sri Rama's work.

records.original_source_text: प्रभु चरित्र सुनिबे को रसिया । राम लखन सीता मन बसिया ॥ ८ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Relishing the narration of the Lord's deeds, in Your heart ever dwell Rama, Lakshmana, and Sita.

records.original_source_text: सूक्ष्म रूप धरि सियहिं दिखावा । बिकट रूप धरि लङ्क जरावा ॥ ९ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Assuming a minute form You appeared before Mother Sita, assuming a colossal form You burnt Lanka.

records.original_source_text: भीम रूप धरि असुर सँहारे । रामचन्द्र के काज सँवारे ॥ १० ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Assuming a formidable form You destroyed demons, successfully carrying out all the missions of Sri Ramachandra.

records.original_source_text: लाय सजीवन लखन जियाये । श्रीरघुबीर हरषि उर लाये ॥ ११ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Bringing the Sanjivani herb You revived Lakshmana, whereupon Sri Rama joyfully embraced You.

records.original_source_text: रघुपति कीन्ही बहुत बड़ाई । तुम मम प्रिय भरतहि सम भाई ॥ १२ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Raghupati praised You lavishly, saying: 'You are as dear to Me as My brother Bharata!'

records.original_source_text: सहस बदन तुम्हरो जस गावैं । अस कहि श्रीपति कण्ठ लगावैं ॥ १३ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: 'May the thousand-mouthed Shesha sing Your renown!' Saying this, the Lord of Sri embraced You.

records.original_source_text: सनकादिक ब्रह्मादि मुनीसा । नारद सारद सहित अहीसा ॥ १४ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Sages like Sanaka, Brahma, Narada, Saraswati, and the serpent king sing Your praises.

records.original_source_text: जम कुबेर दिगपाल जहाँ ते । कबि कोबिद कहि सकैं कहाँ ते ॥ १५ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Yama, Kubera, and the guardians of directions—how can worldly poets and scholars describe Your full glory?

records.original_source_text: तुम उपकार सुग्रीवहिं कीन्हा । राम मिलाय राजपद दीन्हा ॥ १६ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: You rendered great service to Sugriva: introducing him to Sri Rama and restoring his royal throne.

records.original_source_text: तुम्हरो मन्त्र बिभीषन माना । लङ्केस्वर भए सब जग जाना ॥ १७ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Vibhishana heeded Your counsel, becoming the Lord of Lanka, as known to the whole world.

records.original_source_text: जुग सहस्र जोजन पर भानू । लील्यो ताहि मधुर फल जानू ॥ १८ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: The sun situated thousands of leagues away—You swallowed it, mistaking it for a sweet fruit!

records.original_source_text: प्रभु मुद्रिका मेलि मुख माहीं । जलधि लाँघि गये अचरज नाहीं ॥ १९ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Holding the Lord's signet ring in Your mouth, You leaped across the mighty ocean—no wonder at all!

records.original_source_text: दुर्गम काज जगत के जेते । सुगम अनुग्रह तुम्हरे तेते ॥ २० ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: All arduous tasks in this world become effortlessly accomplished by Your divine grace.

records.original_source_text: राम दुआरे तुम रखवारे । होत न आज्ञा बिनु पैसारे ॥ २१ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: You are the gatekeeper at Rama's portal; no one can enter without Your sanction.

records.original_source_text: सब सुख लहै तुम्हारी सरना । तुम रक्षक काहू को डर ना ॥ २२ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: All joy is attained under Your shelter; when You are the protector, who can fear anything?

records.original_source_text: आपन तेज सम्हारो आपै । तीनों लोक हाँक तें काँपै ॥ २३ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: You alone can withstand Your immense radiance; all three worlds tremble when You roar!

records.original_source_text: भूत पिसाच निकट नहिं आवै । महाबीर जब नाम सुनावै ॥ २४ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Ghosts and evil spirits dare not approach when the name of Mahavira is uttered.

records.original_source_text: नासै रोग हरै सब पीरा । जपत निरन्तर हनुमत बीरा ॥ २५ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: All diseases perish and all grief vanishes when one constantly chants the name of courageous Hanuman.

records.original_source_text: सङ्कट तें हनुमान छुड़ावै । मन क्रम बचन ध्यान जो लावै ॥ २६ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Hanuman liberates from all distress those who meditate on Him in thought, deed, and word.

records.original_source_text: सब पर राम तपस्वी राजा । तिन के काज सकल तुम साजा ॥ २७ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Supreme over all is Rama, the ascetic Sovereign; You accomplished every task on His behalf.

records.original_source_text: और मनोरथ जो कोई लावै । सोइ अमित जीवन फल पावै ॥ २८ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Whatever wish anyone brings before You, he secures the inexhaustible fruit of life.

records.original_source_text: चारों जुग परताप तुम्हारा । है परसिद्ध जगत उजियारा ॥ २९ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Your glory shines across all four Yugas; Your renown is celebrated as illumination for the world.

records.original_source_text: साधु सन्त के तुम रखवारे । असुर निकन्दन राम दुलारे ॥ ३० ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: You are the guardian of saints and ascetics, slayer of demons, darling of Sri Rama.

records.original_source_text: अष्ट सिद्धि नौ निधि के दाता । अस बर दीन जानकी माता ॥ ३१ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Bestower of the eight spiritual siddhis and nine divine treasures, as blessed by Mother Janaki.

records.original_source_text: राम रसायन तुम्हरे पासा । सदा रहो रघुपति के दासा ॥ ३२ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: You hold the elixir of Rama's name; You are forever the devoted servant of Raghupati.

records.original_source_text: तुम्हरे भजन राम को पावै । जनम जनम के दुख बिसरावै ॥ ३३ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Through devotion to You, one reaches Sri Rama and sheds the sorrows of countless lifetimes.

records.original_source_text: अन्त काल रघुबर पुर जाई । जहाँ जन्म हरि-भक्त कहाई ॥ ३४ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: At the final hour he departs to Raghuvira's supreme abode, remembered forever as Hari's devotee.

records.original_source_text: और देवता चित्त न धरई । हनुमत सेइ सर्ब सुख करई ॥ ३५ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Even without contemplating any other deity, serving Hanuman alone yields all supreme bliss.

records.original_source_text: सङ्कट कटै मिटै सब पीरा । जो सुमिरै हनुमत बलबीरा ॥ ३६ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: All crises are severed and all pain erased for him who remembers the mighty hero Hanuman.

records.original_source_text: जय जय जय हनुमान गोसाईं । कृपा करहु गुरुदेव की नाईं ॥ ३७ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Hail, hail, hail to Lord Hanuman! Shower Your grace upon me like a divine spiritual Guru!

records.original_source_text: जो सत बार पाठ कर कोई । छूटहि बन्दि महा सुख होई ॥ ३८ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Whoever recites this one hundred times is freed from all bondage and attains supreme happiness.

records.original_source_text: जो यह पढ़ै हनुमान चालीसा । होय सिद्धि साखी गौरीसा ॥ ३९ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Whoever recites this Hanuman Chalisa attains all perfection, as witnessed by Lord Shiva Himself.

records.original_source_text: तुलसीदास सदा हरि चेरा । कीजै नाथ हृदय मँह डेरा ॥ ४० ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Tulsidas is ever the servant of the Lord; O Master, make Your permanent abode in my heart!

supporting_source_references: Scripture: Shaiva Agama / Linga Purana Tradition
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Traditional (Shaiva Agama / Sage Agastya)

records.original_source_text:

records.existing_bhavartha: O Rama, noble son of Kausalya! The morning twilight has dawned. Arise, O lion among men! The sacred morning rituals are to be performed.
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:
उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ गोविन्द उत्तिष्ठ गरुडध्वज ।

records.existing_bhavartha: Arise, arise, O Govinda! Arise, O You who have Garuda on Your banner! Arise, O Beloved of Kamala (Lakshmi)! Bestow auspiciousness upon all three worlds!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:

र्वक्षोविहारिणि मनोहरदिव्यमूर्ते ।
श्रीचन्दनोक्षितपयोधरदिव्यगन्धे
श्रीवेङ्कटेशदयिते तव सुप्रभातम् ॥ ३ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: O Mother of all worlds, who delight upon the chest of the enemy of Madhu and Kaitabha, endowed with an enchanting divine form, fragrant with sacred sandalwood paste! O beloved of Sri Venkatesha, may auspicious dawn greet You!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:

भवतु प्रसन्नमुखचन्द्रमण्डले ।
विधिशङ्करेन्द्रवनिताभिरर्चिते

records.existing_bhavartha: May this dawn be auspicious to You, O lotus-eyed Mother whose radiant face shines like the full moon! Adored by the consorts of Brahma, Shiva, and Indra, O beloved consort of the Lord of Vrishadri, O ocean of mercy!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:

records.existing_bhavartha: Great sages headed by Atri, having concluded their morning prayers, stand with divine reverence awaiting Your blessing, O lotus-eyed Lord of Venkatachala! May auspicious dawn greet You!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:

records.existing_bhavartha: The guardians of all directions headed by Indra and the deities, along with Adisesha and the kings of celestial birds, assemble with folded hands at Your threshold, O Lord of Venkatachala! May auspicious dawn greet You!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:

records.existing_bhavartha: The eastern horizon glows with celestial radiance amid gently blooming lotuses and groves of coconut and areca palms, O Sustainer of all creations, Lord of Venkatachala! May auspicious dawn greet You!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:

records.existing_bhavartha: Delighted by the gentle morning breeze carrying the perfume of blossomed water-lilies, birds warble sweet songs in praise of the Lord of Venkatachala! May auspicious dawn greet You!

records.original_source_text:
वृक्षावलिषु विचरद्भिरनेकपक्षी-
सङ्घैः समुद्गतमनोहरनादनाना ।
लोको विबोध्यत इवास्ति समस्तनाथ
श्रीवेङ्कटाचलपते तव सुप्रभातम् ॥ ९ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Flocks of birds moving through the tree-tops fill the sky with melodious chirping, gently awakening the sleeping world, O Master of the universe, Lord of Venkatachala! May auspicious dawn greet You!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:
सप्तर्षिमण्डलमुपास्य सुपूज्यपादौ
सूर्यादितेजसमिहाभिसमीक्ष्य हृष्टाः ।
गायन्ति साम विविधैः पदपङ्क्तिभेदैः
श्रीवेङ्कटाचलपते तव सुप्रभातम् ॥ १० ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: The constellation of the Seven Sages worships Your venerable feet, chanting divine verses of the Sama Veda in diverse sacred melodies, O Lord of Venkatachala! May auspicious dawn greet You!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:
भ्रातुस्तदीयविमुखैः प्रतिपाद्यमानं
स्तोत्रं निशम्य मुदितैर्मुनिभिश्च मुख्यैः ।
आशीर्वचांसि विबुधाः प्रपठन्ति मोदात्
श्रीवेङ्कटाचलपते तव सुप्रभातम् ॥ ११ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Listening to sacred hymns recited by exalted ascetics, celestials joyously utter auspicious benedictions, O Lord of Venkatachala! May auspicious dawn greet You!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:
देवेन्द्रमुख्यसुरसङ्घमहर्षिसंघाः
संसेवितुं तव विभो चरणौ प्रपन्नाः ।
नेत्रोत्सवाय सुमुखं कुरु मे प्रसन्नं
श्रीवेङ्कटाचलपते तव सुप्रभातम् ॥ १२ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Assemblies of gods headed by Devendra and crowds of great sages have arrived to serve Your feet, O omnipresent Lord! Turn Your radiant face toward us in grace, O Lord of Venkatachala! May auspicious dawn greet You!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:
कञ्जासनादिकविशेखरवन्दिताङ्घ्रे
गङ्गाधरप्रणतपादसरोरुहाक्ष ।
संसारपारमधिगम्य सुपुण्यराशिं
श्रीवेङ्कटाचलपते तव सुप्रभातम् ॥ १३ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: You whose lotus feet are revered by Brahma, Gangadhara (Shiva), and the crest-jewels of poets, granting liberation across the ocean of worldly existence, O Lord of Venkatachala! May auspicious dawn greet You!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:
वीणाप्रपञ्चविपञ्चीश्रुतिमण्डितानि
नानाविधानि मधुरस्वरगीतिकानि ।
शृण्वन्प्रहृष्टहृदयो विबुधैर्नमस्यः
श्रीवेङ्कटाचलपते तव सुप्रभातम् ॥ १४ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Listening to the exquisite melodies of celestial vinas tuned to divine srutis, worshipped by the gods, O Lord of Venkatachala! May auspicious dawn greet You!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:
सप्ताञ्जनाचलपते करुणापयोधि-
कल्लोलशीकरविमिश्रितनेत्रपातैः ।
लोकान्समस्तभुवनान्यभिरक्षमाण
श्रीवेङ्कटाचलपते तव सुप्रभातम् ॥ १५ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: O Sovereign of the seven sacred peaks, who protect all creations with glance-sprinkles from the ocean waves of boundless compassion, O Lord of Venkatachala! May auspicious dawn greet You!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:
लक्ष्मीनिकास निरवद्य सुपूर्णकाम
सर्वज्ञ सर्वसुहृदभयदानदक्ष ।
कारुण्यवारिनिधिरभ्युदयाय नॄणां
श्रीवेङ्कटाचलपते तव सुप्रभातम् ॥ १६ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Abode of Lakshmi, flawless, fulfilled in all desires, omniscient friend of all living beings, expert in granting fearlessness, ocean of mercy for human welfare, O Lord of Venkatachala! May auspicious dawn greet You!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:
कामारिपूजितपदाम्बुज दिव्यमूर्ते
श्रीमत्सहस्रकिरणप्रतिमाप्रभाव ।
भक्तार्तिभञ्जन दयापर सर्वलोके
श्रीवेङ्कटाचलपते तव सुप्रभातम् ॥ १७ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: You whose lotus feet are revered by the conqueror of Kama (Shiva), dazzling like a thousand suns, dispeller of devotees' afflictions, O Lord of Venkatachala! May auspicious dawn greet You!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:
श्रीपद्मनाभ पुरुषोत्तम वासुदेव
वैकुण्ठ माधव जनार्दन चक्रपाणे ।
श्रीवत्सचिह्न शरणागतपारिजात
श्रीवेङ्कटेश भगवन् तव सुप्रभातम् ॥ १८ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: O Padmanabha, Purushottama, Vasudeva, Vaikuntha, Madhava, Janardana, Discus-bearer! Bearing the Srivatsa mark, wishing-tree (Parijata) to all who surrender, O Lord Venkatesha! May auspicious dawn greet You!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:
कन्दर्पदर्पहर सुन्दर दिव्यमूर्ते
कान्तानुकूल कमनीयगुणाभिरामा ।
सर्वप्रपन्नपरिपालनबद्धदीक्ष
श्रीवेङ्कटेश भगवन् तव सुप्रभातम् ॥ १९ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Surpassing the charm of Cupid with Your divine radiance, captivating with graceful attributes, vowed to protect all who take refuge, O Lord Venkatesha! May auspicious dawn greet You!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:
श्रीशैलवास विबुधार्चितपादपद्म
लक्ष्मीनिवास कमलायतपद्मनेत्र ।
श्रीमन् दयानिधिरमन्दगुणामृताब्धे
श्रीवेङ्कटेश भगवन् तव सुप्रभातम् ॥ २० ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Dwelling upon the sacred hill, Your lotus feet worshipped by sages, home of Sri Lakshmi, broad lotus-eyed, nectar-ocean of endless virtues, O Lord Venkatesha! May auspicious dawn greet You!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:
विप्राग्र्यसङ्घपरिगीतसुपुण्यकीर्ते
वेदार्थतत्वनिधये शरणं प्रपन्नाः ।
कारुण्यपूरपरिपोषितसर्वलोक
श्रीवेङ्कटेश भगवन् तव सुप्रभातम् ॥ २१ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Whose sacred glory is sung by assemblies of learned scholars, treasure-house of the essence of the Vedas, nourishing all realms with compassion, O Lord Venkatesha! May auspicious dawn greet You!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:
ब्राह्मे मुहूर्ते विनतानुकृतेन भक्त्या
संसेवितुं समुपगम्य महर्षिसङ्घाः ।
तिष्ठन्ति द्वारि वरदाभयहस्तयुक्त
श्रीवेङ्कटाचलपते तव सुप्रभातम् ॥ २२ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: At the sacred Brahma-muhurta hour, great sages approach Your golden doorway with profound devotion to behold Your hands bestowing boons and fearlessness, O Lord of Venkatachala! May auspicious dawn greet You!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:
स्नानोदकैः परिमलोपमशीततोयैः
संस्थापितैरहिकुलेन्द्रसुरैर्विमिश्रैः ।
अभिषेचनाय भवतो मुदिता भवन्ति
श्रीवेङ्कटाचलपते तव सुप्रभातम् ॥ २३ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Golden pots filled with fragrant cool holy waters stand ready for Your sacred ceremonial bath (Abhisheka), brought joyously by priests and devotees, O Lord of Venkatachala! May auspicious dawn greet You!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:
छत्रचामरवरैरभिशोभमानाः
पादारविन्दयुगलप्रणताः समन्तात् ।
सूर्येन्दुवह्निनयनस्य विभोः प्रपन्नाः
श्रीवेङ्कटाचलपते तव सुप्रभातम् ॥ २४ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Bearing royal parasols and white whisk fans, devotees prostrate around Your pair of lotus feet, O Lord whose eyes are the Sun, Moon, and Fire! O Lord of Venkatachala, may auspicious dawn greet You!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:
वरदाभयमुद्रायुक्तकराञ्चितदिव्यमूर्ते
सर्वज्ञ सर्ववरद प्रथितप्रताप ।
आश्रित्य पादयुगलं कृतकृत्यभाजां
श्रीवेङ्कटाचलपते तव सुप्रभातम् ॥ २५ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Endowed with hands gracefully showing the Varada (boon-giving) and Abhaya (fear-dispelling) mudras, O omniscient granter of all blessings, whose lotus feet crown every endeavor, O Lord of Venkatachala! May auspicious dawn greet You!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:
रामानुजप्रमुखसर्वमहायतीन्द्रैः
संसेव्यमानपदपङ्कजपावनार्ह ।
संसारपारतरणैकसुपोतभूत
श्रीवेङ्कटाचलपते तव सुप्रभातम् ॥ २६ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Whose sacred lotus feet are cherished by eminent preceptors headed by Sri Ramanuja, the solitary unfailing boat across the ocean of worldly existence, O Lord of Venkatachala! May auspicious dawn greet You!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:
देवदुर्लभसुपुण्यकथानुभावैः
लोकान्पुनान परमोत्तमकीर्तिभाजा ।
श्रीशैलशेखरमहारथवाहनाढ्य
श्रीवेङ्कटाचलपते तव सुप्रभातम् ॥ २७ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Purifying all worlds through the divine glory of Your pastimes celebrated even among the celestials, crowned upon the crest of Venkatadri, O Lord of Venkatachala! May auspicious dawn greet You!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:
श्रीमत्क्रियासमुदितैरहरहः प्रवृत्तैः
पुण्याहवाचनपुरस्सरवेदघोषैः ।
उद्घोषितात्मविभवाय मुदान्विताय
श्रीवेङ्कटाचलपते तव सुप्रभातम् ॥ २८ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Amid resonant Vedic chants and auspicious invocations resounding daily in rituals performed with profound joy, O glorious Lord of Venkatachala! May auspicious dawn greet You!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:
इत्थं वृषाचलपतेरिह सुप्रभातं
ये मानवाः प्रतिदिनं पठितुं प्रवृत्ताः ।
तेषां प्रभातसमये स्मृतिकर्तृभाजां
प्रज्ञां परां च परमां श्रियमिन्दुरुचिं प्रयच्छ ॥ २९ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Those who daily recite this morning hymn of the Lord of Vrishachala at dawn with devoted remembrance — to them may You bestow transcendent wisdom, supreme spiritual prosperity, and everlasting tranquility radiant as the moon!
supporting_source_references: Attributed Composer/Rishi: Prativadi Bhayankaram Anna (c. 1400 CE)

records.original_source_text:
सहस्र॑शीर्षा पुरु॑षः सहस्रा॒क्षः स॒हस्र॑पात् ।
स भूमिं॑ वि॒श्वतो॑ वृ॒त्वात्य॑तिष्ठद्दशाङ्गु॒लम् ॥ १ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: The Supreme Purusha has a thousand heads, a thousand eyes, and a thousand feet. Pervading the entire cosmos on all sides, He extends beyond it by ten fingers' length.

records.original_source_text:
पुरु॑ष ए॒वेदं सर्वं॒ यद्भू॒तं यच्च॒ भव्य॑म् ।
उ॒तामृ॑त॒त्वस्येशा॑नो॒ यदन्ने॑नाति॒रोह॑ति ॥ २ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: The Purusha alone is all this universe — all that has been and all that is yet to come. He is also the immortal Lord of eternal life, who grows beyond mortal existence through sustenance.

records.original_source_text:
ए॒तावा॑नस्य महि॒मातो॒ ज्यायां॑श्च॒ पूरु॑षः ।
पादो॑ऽस्य॒ विश्वा॑ भू॒तानि॑ त्रि॒पाद॑स्या॒मृतं॑ दि॒वि ॥ ३ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Such is His magnificent greatness, yet greater still is the supreme Purusha. All beings and creations of the universe constitute but one quarter of Him; His immortal three-quarters abide in the transcendent realms.

records.original_source_text:
त्रि॒पादू॒र्ध्व उदै॒त्पुरु॑षः पादो॑ऽस्ये॒हाभ॑व॒त्पुनः॑ ।
ततो॒ विष्व॒ङ् व्य॑क्रामत्साशनानश॒ने अ॒भि ॥ ४ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: With His three-quarters the Purusha ascended into supreme transcendence, while one quarter manifested here again. From that quarter He expanded in all directions over everything that consumes food and that does not.

records.original_source_text:
तस्मा॑द्वि॒राळ॑जायत वि॒राजो॒ अधि॒ पूरु॑षः ।
स जा॒तो अत्य॑रिच्यत प॒श्चाद्भूमि॒मथो॑ पु॒रः ॥ ५ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: From Him was born the cosmic body Viraj, and from Viraj was manifested the cosmic Purusha. Being born, He spread far beyond the earth, both behind and in front.

records.original_source_text:
यत्पुरु॑षेण ह॒विषा॑ दे॒वा य॒ज्ञमत॑न्वत ।
व॒स॒न्तो अ॑स्यासी॒दाज्यं॑ ग्री॒ष्म इ॒ध्मः श॒रद्ध॒विः ॥ ६ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: When the divine powers performed the cosmic sacrifice with the Purusha as the offering, spring became its clarified butter, summer its sacred fuel, and autumn its oblatory oblation.

records.original_source_text:
स॒प्तास्या॑सन्परि॒धय॒स्त्रिः स॒प्त स॒मिधः॑ कृ॒ताः ।
दे॒वा यद्य॒ज्ञं त॑न्वा॒ना अब॑ध्न॒न्पुरु॑षं प॒शुम् ॥ ७ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Seven were its enclosing border-sticks, and thrice seven (twenty-one) fuel-logs were prepared, when the divine powers offering the cosmic sacrifice bound the Purusha as the sacred victim.

records.original_source_text:
तं य॒ज्ञं ब॒र्हिषि॒ प्रौक्ष॒न्पुरु॑षं जा॒तम॑ग्र॒तः ।
तेन॑ दे॒वा अय॑जन्त सा॒ध्या ऋष॑यश्च॒ ये ॥ ८ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: They sprinkled with sacred waters that Purusha, the primordial sacrifice born at the very beginning, upon the sacred sacrificial grass. With Him the deities, the Sadhyas, and the ancient seers offered the sacrifice.

records.original_source_text:
तस्मा॑द्य॒ज्ञात्स॑र्व॒हुतः॒ संभृ॑तं पृषदा॒ज्यम् ।
प॒शून्तांश्च॑क्रे वाय॒व्यानार॒ण्यान् ग्राम्या॑श्च॒ ये ॥ ९ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: From that cosmic sacrifice in which everything was offered, speckled butter (clarified butter and curds) was collected. From it were formed the creatures ruled by Vayu (air), both wild beasts of the forest and domestic animals.

records.original_source_text:
तस्मा॑द्य॒ज्ञात्स॑र्व॒हुत॒ ऋचः॒ सामा॑नि जज्ञिरे ।
च्छन्दां॑सि जज्ञिरे॒ तस्मा॒द्यजु॒स्तस्मा॑दजायत ॥ १० ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: From that all-embracing sacrifice the Rig hymns and Sama chants were born. From it the sacred metres were produced, and from it the Yajus sacrificial formulas arose.

records.original_source_text:
तस्मा॒दश्वा॑ अजायन्त॒ ये के चो॑भ॒याद॑तः ।
गावो॑ ह जज्ञिरे॒ तस्मा॒त्तस्मा॑ज्जा॒ता अ॑जा॒वयः॑ ॥ ११ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: From it horses were generated, and all animals possessing two rows of teeth. Cattle were born from it, and from it were born goats and sheep.

records.original_source_text:
यत्पुरु॑षं व्य॒दधुः॒ कति॒धा व्य॑कल्पयन् ।
मुखं॒ किम॑स्य॒ कौ बा॒हू कावू॒रू पादा॑वुच्येते ॥ १२ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: When they partitioned the Purusha, into how many portions did they divide Him? What was His mouth called? What were His arms, His thighs, and His feet named?

records.original_source_text:
ब्रा॒ह्म॒णो॑ऽस्य॒ मुख॑मासीद्बा॒हू रा॑ज॒न्यः॑ कृ॒तः ।
ऊ॒रू तद॑स्य॒ यद्वैश्यः॑ प॒द्भ्यां शू॒द्रो अ॑जायत ॥ १३ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: The Brahmana (priest/scholar) was His mouth; the Rajanya (warrior/king) was made from His arms; His thighs became the Vaishya (merchant/agriculturist); from His feet the Shudra (service-provider) was born.

records.original_source_text:
च॒न्द्रमा॒ मन॑सो जा॒तश्चक्षोः॒ सूर्यो॑ अजायत ।
मुखा॒दिन्द्र॑श्चा॒ग्निश्च॑ प्रा॒णाद्वा॒युर॑जायत ॥ १४ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: The Moon was born from His mind; from His eyes the Sun was generated; from His mouth arose Indra and Agni (fire); and from His breath Vayu (vital air) was born.

records.original_source_text:
नाभ्या॑ आसीद॒न्तरि॑क्षं शी॒र्ष्णो द्यौः सम॑वर्तत ।
प॒द्भ्यां भूमि॒र्दिशः॒ श्रोत्रा॒त्तथा॑ लो॒काँ अक॑ल्पयन् ॥ १५ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: From His navel the intermediate atmosphere arose; from His head the heavens evolved; from His feet the earth emerged, and the cardinal directions from His ears. In this manner they ordered all the cosmic realms.

records.original_source_text:
य॒ज्ञेन॑ य॒ज्ञम॑यजन्त दे॒वास्तानि॒ धर्मा॑णि प्रथ॒मान्या॑सन् ।
ते ह॒ नाकं॑ महि॒मानः॑ सचन्त॒ यत्र॒ पूर्वे॑ सा॒ध्याः सन्ति॑ दे॒वाः ॥ १६ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: With sacrifice the deities offered worship to the Supreme Sacrifice (Purusha). These became the primordial cosmic ordinances (Dharmas). Those exalted spiritual beings attain the highest celestial realm where the ancient Sadhyas and gods abide.

records.original_source_text:
जा॒तवे॑दसे सुनवाम॒ सोम॑मरातीय॒तो निद॑हाति॒ वेदः॑ ।
स नः॑ पर्ष॒दति॑ दु॒र्गाणि॒ विश्वा॑ ना॒वेव॒ सिन्धुं॑ दुरि॒तात्य॒ग्निः ॥ १ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: We press the sacred Soma juice unto Jatavedas (Agni, Knower of all beings). May He consume the enmity of our tormentors. May Agni carry us safely across all formidable perils and difficulties, as a ship conveys passengers across the roaring ocean!

records.original_source_text:
ताम॒ग्निव॑र्णां॒ तप॑सा ज्वल॒न्तीं वै॑रोच॒नीं क॑र्मफ॒लेषु॒ जुष्टाम् ।
दु॒र्गां दे॒वीं शर॑णम॒हं प्रप॑द्ये सु॒तर॑सि तरसे॒ नमः॑ ॥ २ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Unto Her who shines with fiery luster, burning with ascetic radiance, daughter of the Divine Light (Vairochani), delighted in the righteous fruits of works — unto that Goddess Durga I take refuge! O Deliverer supreme across the ocean of delusion, salutations unto Your swift rescuing power!

records.original_source_text:
अग्ने॒ त्वं पा॑रया॒ नव्यो॑ अ॒स्मान्स्व॒स्तिभि॒रति॑ दु॒र्गाणि॒ विश्वा॑ ।
पूश्च॑ पृ॒थ्वी ब॑हु॒ला न॑ उ॒र्वी भवा॑ तो॒काय॒ तन॑याय॒ शं योः ॥ ३ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: O Agni, ever youthful and praiseworthy! Carry us across all afflictions and dangers with auspicious blessings. May our city and earth be wide and bountiful; bestow supreme welfare, peace, and protection upon our children and future generations!

records.original_source_text:
विश्वा॑नि नो दु॒र्गहा॑ जातवेदः॒ सिन्धुं॒ न ना॒वा दु॑रि॒ताऽति॑पर्षि ।
अग्ने॑ अत्रिव॒न्मन॑सा गृणा॒नोऽस्माकं॑ बोध्यवि॒ता त॒नूनाम् ॥ ४ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: O Jatavedas! Safely convey us past all impassable barriers and sins, just as a boatman ferries passengers across the surging sea. O Agni, celebrated in prayer like Sage Atri, awaken as the perpetual guardian and protector of our lives!

records.original_source_text:
पृत॑ना॒जितं॒ सह॑मानमु॒ग्रम॒ग्निं हु॑वेम पर॒मात्स॒धस्था॑त् ।
स नः॑ पर्ष॒दति॑ दु॒र्गाणि॒ विश्वा॒ क्षाम॑द्देवो अतिदुरि॒तात्य॒ग्निः ॥ ५ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: We invoke Agni, the conqueror of hostile armies, triumphant and formidable, from His supreme celestial assembly! May He, the luminous God, consume our transgressions and transport us safely across every tribulation!

records.original_source_text:
प्र॒त्नोषि॑ क॒मीड्यो॑ अध्व॒रेषु॑ स॒नाच्च॒ होता॒ नव्य॑श्च॒ सत्सि॑ ।
स्वाञ्चा॑ग्ने त॒नुवं॑ पि॒प्रय॑स्वा॒स्मभ्यं॑ च॒ सौभ॑ग॒माय॑जस्व ॥ ६ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: You are praiseworthy in all sacred sacrifices since ancient times; You are the eternal Priest (Hota), yet ever fresh and new! O Agni, delight in Your own divine form and bestow glorious auspiciousness, spiritual wealth, and fortune upon us!

records.original_source_text:
गोभि॒र्जुष्ट॒मयु॑जो॒ निषि॑क्तं॒ तवे॑न्द्र विष्णो॒रनु॒संच॑रेम ।
नाक॑स्य पृ॒ष्ठम॒भि सं॒वसा॑नो॒ वैष्ण॑वीं लो॒क इ॒ह मा॑दयन्ताम् ॥ ७ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Blessed with spiritual wisdom, may we walk in harmony with Indra and Vishnu! Ascending to the radiant summit of the highest heaven, established in the transcendent Vaishnavi realm, may the seekers rejoice in everlasting bliss!

records.original_source_text:
स॒हस्र॑शीर्षं देवं॒ वि॒श्वाक्षं॑ वि॒श्वश॑म्भुवम् ।
विश्वं॑ ना॒राय॑णं दे॒व॒म॒क्षरं॑ पर॒मं पदम् ॥ १ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: We meditate upon the Supreme Lord Narayana, who has a thousand heads, who is all-seeing (with eyes everywhere), who is the source of all auspiciousness and happiness to the universe, who is the universe itself, imperishable, and the supreme goal.

records.original_source_text:
विश्व॑तः पर॒मान्नि॒त्यं॒ वि॒श्वं ना॑राय॒णं हरि॑म् ।
विश्व॑मे॒वेदं पुरु॑ष॒स्तद्विश्व॒मुप॑जीवति ॥ २ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Narayana is the supreme transcendent reality beyond all cosmos, eternal. Narayana is Hari, the all-pervading universe. This entire cosmos is the Purusha alone; upon Him the whole universe depends for its existence.

records.original_source_text:
पतिं॒ विश्व॑स्या॒त्मेश्‍व॑रं॒ शाश्व॑तं शि॒वम॑च्युतम् ।
ना॒राय॒णं म॑हाज्ञे॒यं॒ वि॒श्वात्मा॑नं प॑राय॒णम् ॥ ३ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: He is the Sovereign of the universe, the Lord of all souls, eternal, all-auspicious, and imperishable. Narayana is the supreme object of knowledge, the innermost Soul of the universe, and the supreme refuge of all.

records.original_source_text:
ना॒राय॒णः प॑रो ज्योति॒रा॒त्मा ना॑राय॒णः प॑रः ।
ना॒राय॒णः प॑रं ब्र॒ह्म॒ तत्त्वं ना॑राय॒णः प॑रः ।
ना॒राय॒णः प॑रो ध्या॒ता॒ ध्या॒नं ना॑राय॒णः प॑रः ॥ ४ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Narayana is the supreme light. Narayana is the supreme Self. Narayana is the supreme Brahman. Narayana is the supreme truth. Narayana is the supreme meditator, and Narayana is the supreme meditation.

records.original_source_text:
यच्च॑ कि॒ञ्चिज्जग॑त्सर्वं॒ दृ॒श्यते॑ श्रूय॒तेऽपि॑ वा ।
अन्त॑र्ब॒हिश्च॑ तत्सर्वं॒ व्या॒प्य ना॑राय॒णः स्थि॑तः ॥ ५ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Whatever exists in this universe, whether seen or heard — Narayana pervades all of that completely, both from within and from without.

records.original_source_text:
अन॑न्त॒मव्य॑यं क॒विं समु॒द्रेऽन्तं॑ वि॒श्वश॑म्भुवम् ।
प॒द्म॒को॒शप्र॑तीका॒शं॒ हृ॒दयं॑ चाप्यधोमुखम् ॥ ६ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: The infinite, imperishable, all-seeing Seer, who resides in the cosmic waters of consciousness, the source of supreme auspiciousness! Resembling an inverted lotus bud is the subtle spiritual heart.

records.original_source_text:
अधो॑ नि॒ष्ट्या वि॑तस्त्या॒न्ते॒ नाभ्या॑मुप॑रि तिष्ठति ।
ज्वा॒ल॒मा॒लाकु॑लं भा॒ती॒ वि॒श्वस्या॑यत॒नं म॑हत् ॥ ७ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Located below the throat and a span (vitasti) above the navel, glowing with a garland of celestial flames, stands that great sanctuary of the entire universe.

records.original_source_text:
स॒न्त॒तं शि॒लाभि॑स्तु॒ लम्ब॑त्याकोश॒सन्नि॑भम् ।
तस्यान्ते॑ सुषि॒रं सू॒क्ष्मं तस्मि॑न्त्सर्वं॒ प्रति॑ष्ठितम् ॥ ८ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Surrounded by delicate veins (nadis), hanging like an unopened flower bud, at its apex is a subtle microscopic aperture (sushira); in that subtle space, everything in creation is established.

records.original_source_text:
तस्य॒ मध्यें॑ म॒हान॑ग्नि॒र्विश्वार्चि॑र्वि॒श्वतो॑मुखः ।
सोऽग्र॑भु॒ग्विभ॑जन्ति॒ष्ठ॒न्नाहा॑रमज॒रः क॒विः ॥ ९ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: In the center of that heart-space burns a great cosmic fire, radiating all rays, facing every direction. He is the first consumer of nourishment, distributing it throughout the body, ageless and all-knowing.

records.original_source_text:
ति॒र्य॒गू॒र्ध्वम॑धःशा॒यी॒ र॒श्मय॑स्तस्य सन्तताः ।
स॒न्ता॒पय॑ति स्वं दे॒हमापा॑दतलमस्त॒कः ॥ १० ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Its radiant rays spread horizontally, upward, and downward, warming and energizing its own bodily vessel from the soles of the feet to the crown of the head.

records.original_source_text:
तस्य॒ मध्यें॒ वह्निशिखा अणी॑यो॒र्ध्वा व्य॑वस्थि॒ता ।
नी॒लतो॑यद॒मध्य॑स्थाद् वि॒द्युल्ले॑खेव भास्व॒रा ॥ ११ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: In the center of that fire stands an exceedingly subtle flame pointing upward, brilliant and dazzling like a flash of golden lightning in the heart of a dark rain-bearing cloud.

records.original_source_text:
तस्याः॑ शिखा॒या म॑ध्ये प॒रमा॑त्मा व्य॒वस्थि॑तः ।
स ब्र॒ह्मा स शि॒वः स हरिः॒ स इन्द्रः॒ सोऽक्षरः॑ पर॒मः स्व॒राट् ॥ १२ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: In the very core of that subtle flame resides the Supreme Paramatman. He is Brahma, He is Shiva, He is Hari (Vishnu), He is Indra; He is the Imperishable, the Supreme, and the Self-Luminous Sovereign!

records.original_source_text:
आदिदेव नमस्तुभ्यं प्रसीद मम भास्कर ।
दिवाकर नमस्तुभ्यं प्रभाकर नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ १ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: হে আদিদেব, হে দিবাকর, হে ভাস্কর! আপনাকে আমার সশ্রদ্ধ প্রণাম, আপনি আমার প্রতি প্রসন্ন হোন। নিখিল বিশ্বের আলোকময় প্রভু সূর্যদেবকে বারংবার নমস্কার।
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Samba Purana / Saura Stotra Samgraha
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Samba Purana / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text:
आदिदेव नमस्तुभ्यं प्रसीद मम भास्कर ।
दिवाकर नमस्तुभ्यं प्रभाकर नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ १ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Salutations to You, O Primordial God! Be gracious unto me, O Bhaskara (Creator of Light)! Salutations to You, O Divakara (Maker of the Day)! Salutations unto You, O Prabhakara (Maker of Splendor)!
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Samba Purana / Saura Stotra Samgraha
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Samba Purana / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text:
आदिदेव नमस्तुभ्यं प्रसीद मम भास्कर ।
दिवाकर नमस्तुभ्यं प्रभाकर नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ १ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: હે આદિદેવ, હે દિવાકર, હે ભાસ્કર! આપને મારા પ્રણામ, આપ મારા પર પ્રસન્ન થાઓ. સમસ્ત જગતને પ્રકાશ આપનારા સૂર્યદેવ, આપને વારંવાર નમસ્કાર.
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Samba Purana / Saura Stotra Samgraha
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Samba Purana / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text:
आदिदेव नमस्तुभ्यं प्रसीद मम भास्कर ।
दिवाकर नमस्तुभ्यं प्रभाकर नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ १ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: हे आदिदेव, हे दिनकर, हे भास्कर! आपको मेरा सादर प्रणाम है, आप मुझ पर प्रसन्न हों। संपूर्ण जगत को प्रकाशित करने वाले हे सूर्यदेव, आपको बारंबार नमस्कार है।
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Samba Purana / Saura Stotra Samgraha
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Samba Purana / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text:
आदिदेव नमस्तुभ्यं प्रसीद मम भास्कर ।
दिवाकर नमस्तुभ्यं प्रभाकर नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ १ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: ಹೇ ಆದಿದೇವನೇ, ಭಾಸ್ಕರನೇ, ನಿನಗೆ ನಮಸ್ಕಾರಗಳು; ನನ್ನ ಮೇಲೆ ಪ್ರಸನ್ನನಾಗು. ಸಮಸ್ತ ಜಗತ್ತನ್ನು ಬೆಳಗುವ ದಿವಾಕರನೇ, ಸೂರ್ಯದೇವನೇ, ನಿನಗೆ ಪುನಃಪುನಃ ನಮಸ್ಕರಿಸುತ್ತೇನೆ.
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Samba Purana / Saura Stotra Samgraha
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Samba Purana / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text:
आदिदेव नमस्तुभ्यं प्रसीद मम भास्कर ।
दिवाकर नमस्तुभ्यं प्रभाकर नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ १ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: ഹേ ആദിദേവാ, ദിവാകരാ, ഭാസ്കരാ! അങ്ങേയ്ക്ക് പ്രണാമം; എന്നിൽ പ്രസാദിച്ചരുളേണമേ. ജഗത്തിനെ പ്രകാശിപ്പിക്കുന്ന സൂര്യഭഗവാനേ, അങ്ങയെ വണങ്ങുന്നു.
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Samba Purana / Saura Stotra Samgraha
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Samba Purana / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text:
आदिदेव नमस्तुभ्यं प्रसीद मम भास्कर ।
दिवाकर नमस्तुभ्यं प्रभाकर नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ १ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: हे आदिदेव, हे दिवाकर, हे भास्कर! तुम्हाला माझे वंदन असो, आपण माझ्यावर प्रसन्न व्हा. संपूर्ण जगाला प्रकाश देणाऱ्या हे सूर्यदेव, तुम्हाला माझा नमस्कार असो.
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Samba Purana / Saura Stotra Samgraha
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Samba Purana / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text:
आदिदेव नमस्तुभ्यं प्रसीद मम भास्कर ।
दिवाकर नमस्तुभ्यं प्रभाकर नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ १ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: ହେ ଆଦିଦେବ, ହେ ଦିବାକର, ହେ ଭାସ୍କର! ଆପଣଙ୍କୁ ମୋର ପ୍ରଣାମ, ଆପଣ ମୋ ଉପରେ ପ୍ରସନ୍ନ ହୁଅନ୍ତୁ । ସମସ୍ତ ଜଗତକୁ ଆଲୋକିତ କରୁଥିବା ସୂର୍ଯ୍ୟଦେବଙ୍କୁ ବାରମ୍ବାର ନମସ୍କାର ।
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Samba Purana / Saura Stotra Samgraha
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Samba Purana / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text:
आदिदेव नमस्तुभ्यं प्रसीद मम भास्कर ।
दिवाकर नमस्तुभ्यं प्रभाकर नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ १ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: ஆதிதேவரே, திவாகரரே, பாஸ்கரரே! தங்களுக்கு என் பணிவான வணக்கங்கள், என்மீது கருணை புரிவீராக. உலகிற்கு ஒளியூட்டும் சூரிய பகவானே, உமக்கு மீண்டும் மீண்டும் நமஸ்காரம்.
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Samba Purana / Saura Stotra Samgraha
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Samba Purana / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text:

records.existing_bhavartha: ಯಾರು ನಿತ್ಯವೂ ಈ ಸೂರ್ಯಾಷ್ಟಕವನ್ನು ಪಠಿಸುವರೋ, ಅವರ ಸಮಸ್ತ ಗ್ರಹಪೀಡೆಗಳು ಪರಿಹಾರವಾಗುತ್ತವೆ; ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಲ್ಲದವರಿಗೆ ಮಕ್ಕಳೂ, ಧನವಿಲ್ಲದವರಿಗೆ ಅಪಾರ ಐಶ್ವರ್ಯವೂ ಲಭಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Samba Purana / Saura Stotra Samgraha
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Samba Purana / Sage Agastya

Attributed Composer/Rishi: Samba Purana / Sage Agastya

आमिषं मधुपानं च यः करोति रवेर्दिने ।
सप्तजन्म भवेद्रोगी जन्मजन्म दरिद्रता ॥ १० ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: যিনি রবিবার দিনে তামসিক আহার পরিত্যাগ করে ভক্তিভরে সূর্যদেবের আরাধনা করেন, তিনি সপ্তজন্মের সঞ্চিত পাপ, রোগ ও দারিদ্র্য থেকে চিরতরে মুক্তি লাভ করেন।
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Samba Purana / Saura Stotra Samgraha
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Samba Purana / Sage Agastya

records.existing_bhavartha: Whoever consumes meat or intoxicating drinks on Sunday (the day of the Sun) suffers illness for seven births and poverty birth after birth. Therefore, let one worship the Sun with purity.
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Samba Purana / Saura Stotra Samgraha
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Samba Purana / Sage Agastya

records.existing_bhavartha: ഞായറാഴ്ചകളിൽ തമോഗുണഭോജനങ്ങളെ വെടിഞ്ഞു സൂര്യദേവനെ ആരാധിക്കുന്ന ഭക്തൻ ഏഴു ജന്മങ്ങളിലെ സഞ്ചിതപാപങ്ങളിൽനിന്നും രോഗങ്ങളിൽനിന്നും ദാരിദ്ര്യത്തിൽനിന്നും മുക്തനാകും.

records.existing_bhavartha: ଯେଉଁ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି ରବିବାର ଦିନ ତାମସିକ ଆହାର ତ୍ୟାଗ କରି ସୂର୍ଯ୍ୟଦେବଙ୍କ ଆରାଧନା କରେ, ସେ ସାତ ଜନ୍ମର ପାପ, ରୋଗ ଓ ଦାରିଦ୍ର୍ୟରୁ ସର୍ବଦା ପାଇଁ ମୁକ୍ତ ହୁଏ ।

सप्तजन्म भवेद्रोगी जन्मजन्म दरिद्रता ॥ १० ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: ஞாயிற்றுக்கிழமைகளில் தவறான உணவுப் பழக்கங்களை விடுத்துச் சூரிய பகவானை வழிபடும் பக்தன், தன் ஏழு பிறவிகளின் பாவங்கள், பிணிகள், வறுமை ஆகியவற்றிலிருந்து விடுபடுவான்.
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Samba Purana / Saura Stotra Samgraha
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Samba Purana / Sage Agastya
