सप्तजन्म भवेद्रोगी जन्मजन्म दरिद्रता ॥ १० ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: ఎవరైతే ఆదివారమునాడు తామసిక ఆహారములను విడనాడి భక్తితో సూర్యదేవుని ఆరాధింతురో, వారు ఏడు జన్మల పాపముల నుండి, రోగదారిద్ర్యముల నుండి విముక్తులగుదురు.
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Samba Purana / Saura Stotra Samgraha
Attributed Composer/Rishi: Samba Purana / Sage Agastya

records.original_source_text:
अङ्गं हरेः पुलकभूषणमाश्रयन्ती
भृङ्गाङ्गनेव मुकुलाभरणं तमालम् ।
अङ्गीकृताखिलविभूतिरपाङ्गलीला
माङ्गल्यदास्तु मम मङ्गलदेवतायाः ॥ १ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Like a honeybee resting upon a dark blossom-laden Tamala tree, the glance of Goddess Sri Lakshmi rests on the dark form of Lord Hari, causing hairs of divine joy to thrill. May that glance of the Goddess of all auspiciousness bestow prosperity upon me!

records.original_source_text:
मुग्धा मुहुर्विदधती वदने मुरारेः
प्रेमत्रपाप्रणिहितानि गतागतानि ।
माला दृशोर्मधुकरीव महोत्पले या
सा मे श्रियं दिशतु सागरसंभवायाः ॥ २ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Gazing coyly upon the face of Murari, moving back and forth with love and modesty like bees hovering around a grand blue lotus — may that glance of the ocean-born Goddess bestow auspicious wealth upon me!

records.original_source_text:
आमीलिताक्षमधिगम्य मुदा मुकुन्दम्
आनन्दकन्दमनिमेषमनङ्गतन्त्रम् ।
आकेकरस्थितकनीनिकपक्ष्मनेत्रं
भूत्यै भवेन्मम भुजङ्गशयाङ्गनायाः ॥ ३ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Looking upon Lord Mukunda, the root of bliss, who blissfully closes His eyes in transcendental slumber, may the half-closed, tenderly glancing eyes of the consort of the serpent-reclining Lord bring boundless spiritual abundance unto me!

records.original_source_text:
बाह्वन्तरे मधुजितः श्रितकौस्तुभे या
हारावलीव हरिनीलमयी विभाति ।
कामप्रदा भगवतोऽपि कटाक्षमाला
कल्याणमावहतु मे कमलालयायाः ॥ ४ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Shining like a necklace of sapphires upon the Kaustubha-adorned bosom of Madhusudana, awakening love even in the Supreme Lord Himself — may that glance of Kamala (Lakshmi) bring supreme blessings unto me!

records.original_source_text:
कालाम्बुदालिललितोरसि कैटभारे-
र्धाराधरे स्फुरति या तडिदङ्गनेव ।
मातुः समस्तजगतां महनीयमूर्तिः
भद्राणि मे दिशतु भार्गवनन्दनायाः ॥ ५ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Flashing like brilliant lightning upon the dark rain-cloud bosom of the enemy of Kaitabha, majestic mother of all creation, daughter of Sage Bhrigu — may Her compassionate gaze shower auspiciousness upon me!

records.original_source_text:
प्राप्तं पदं प्रथमतः खलु यत्प्रभावा-
न्माङ्गल्यभाजि मधुमाथिनि मन्मथेन ।
मय्यापतेत्तदिह मन्थरमीक्षणार्धं
मन्दालसं च मकरालयकन्यकायाः ॥ ६ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: By the sheer potency of whose grace Kamadeva (Cupid) regained his realm upon the conqueror of Madhu, may that gentle, benevolent half-glance of the daughter of the ocean fall graciously upon me!

records.original_source_text:
विश्वामरेन्द्रपदविभ्रमदानदक्षम्
आनन्दहेतुरधिकं मुरविद्विषोऽपि ।
ईषन्निषीदतु मयि क्षणमीक्षणार्धम्
इन्दीवरोदरसहोदरमिन्दिरायाः ॥ ७ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Capable of bestowing sovereignty even over all celestial realms, the supreme cause of divine delight to the Lord, resembling the deep blue heart of a blossoming lotus — may that gentle glance of Indira dwell upon me!

records.original_source_text:
इष्टा विशिष्टमतयोऽपि यया दयार्द्र-
दृष्ट्या त्रिविष्टपपदं सुलभं लभन्ते ।
दृष्टिः प्रहृष्टकमलोदरदीप्तिरिष्टां
पुष्टिं कृषीष्ट मम पुष्करविष्टरायाः ॥ ८ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: By whose glance moist with mercy even ordinary seekers effortlessly attain highest heaven, brilliant like the core of an open lotus — may the gaze of Her who sits upon the lotus seat nourish my life with fullness!

records.original_source_text:
दद्याद्दयानुपवनो द्रविणाम्बुधारा-
मस्मिन्नकिञ्चनविहङ्गशिशौ विषण्णे ।
दुष्कर्मघर्ममपनीय चिराय दूरं
नारायणप्रणयिनीनयनाम्बुवाहः ॥ ९ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: May the cloud of Narayana's beloved's compassionate eyes, impelled by the breeze of Her mercy, shower a torrent of gold and fortune upon this destitute fledgling bird (myself), driving far away the scorch of past sins!

records.original_source_text:
गीर्देवतेति गरुडध्वजसुन्दरीति
शाकम्भरीति शशिशेखरवल्लभेति ।
सृष्टिस्थितिप्रलयकेलिषु संस्थितायै
तस्यै नमस्त्रिभुवनैकगुरोस्तरुण्यै ॥ १० ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Revering Her as Sarasvati (wisdom), Lakshmi (consort of Vishnu), Shakambhari, and Parvati (consort of Shiva), presiding over creation, preservation, and dissolution — salutations unto that maiden consort of the Supreme Guru of the three worlds!

records.original_source_text:
श्रुत्यै नमोऽस्तु शुभकर्मफलप्रसूत्यै
रत्यै नमोऽस्तु रमणीयगुणार्णवायै ।
शक्त्यै नमोऽस्तु शतपत्रनिकेतनायै
पुष्ट्यै नमोऽस्तु पुरुषोत्तमवल्लभायै ॥ ११ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Salutations to You as Shruti (the Vedas) bestowing the fruits of righteous deeds! Salutations as Rati, the ocean of endearing virtues! Salutations as Shakti, enthroned upon the hundred-petaled lotus! Salutations as Pushti, beloved of Purushottama!

records.original_source_text:
नमोऽस्तु नालीकनिभाननायै
नमोऽस्तु दुग्धोदधिजन्मभूम्यै ।
नमोऽस्तु सोमामृतसोदरायै
नमोऽस्तु नारायणवल्लभायै ॥ १२ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Salutations to Her whose face is fair as the blooming lotus! Salutations to Her whose birthplace is the Milky Ocean! Salutations to the sister of the Moon and divine nectar! Salutations to the beloved of Narayana!

records.original_source_text:
नमोऽस्तु हेमाम्बुजपीठिकायै
नमोऽस्तु भूमण्डलनायिकायै ।
नमोऽस्तु देवादिदयापरायै
नमोऽस्तु शार्ङ्गयुधवल्लभायै ॥ १३ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Salutations to Her seated upon the golden lotus altar! Salutations to the Sovereign Empress of the entire earth! Salutations to Her who overflows with mercy toward the gods! Salutations to the beloved consort of the bearer of the Sarnga bow!

records.original_source_text:
नमोऽस्तु देव्यै भृगुनन्दनायै
नमोऽस्तु विष्णोरुरसि स्थितायै ।
नमोऽस्तु लक्ष्म्यै कमलालयायै
नमोऽस्तु दामोदरवल्लभायै ॥ १४ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Salutations to the divine daughter of Sage Bhrigu! Salutations to Her who ever abides upon the chest of Vishnu! Salutations to Lakshmi, dwelling in the lotus! Salutations to the beloved consort of Damodara!

records.original_source_text:
नमोऽस्तु कान्त्यै कमलेक्षणायै
नमोऽस्तु भूत्यै भुवनप्रसूत्यै ।
नमोऽस्तु देवादिभिरर्चितायै
नमोऽस्तु नन्दात्मजवल्लभायै ॥ १५ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Salutations to Her who is radiant beauty incarnate with lotus eyes! Salutations to Her who is wealth and mother of all worlds! Salutations to Her adored by all celestials! Salutations to the beloved of the son of Nanda!

records.original_source_text:
सम्पत्कराणि सकलेन्द्रियनन्दनानि
साम्राज्यदानविभवानि सरोरुहाणि ।
त्वद्वन्दनानि दुरिताहरणोद्यतानि
मामेव मातरनिशं कलयन्तु मान्ये ॥ १६ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Bestowing wealth, delighting all senses, endowed with the power to confer celestial sovereignty, dispelling all sins — may prostrations to You, O venerable Mother, ever purify and uplift me day and night!

records.original_source_text:
यत्कटाक्षसमुपासनाविधिः
सेवकस्य सकलार्थसम्पदः ।
संतनोति वचनाङ्गमानसै-
स्त्वां मुरारिहृदयेश्वरीं भजे ॥ १७ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: By the contemplation of whose compassionate glance all fourfold aims of life blossom for the servant — unto You, Empress of Murari's heart, I offer worship through word, body, and mind!

records.original_source_text:
सरसिजनिलये सरोजहस्ते
धवलतमांशुकगन्धमाल्यशोभे ।
भगवति हरिवल्लभे मनोज्ञे
त्रिभुवनभूतिकरि प्रसीद मह्यम् ॥ १८ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Dwelling in the lotus, holding lotuses in Your hands, dazzling in pristine white robes, fragrant with celestial garlands, adorable consort of Hari, conferring fortune on all three worlds — O Divine Mother, be merciful unto me!

records.original_source_text:
दिङ्घस्तिभिः कनककुम्भमुखावसृष्ट-
स्वर्वाहिनीविमलचारुजलप्लुताङ्गीम् ।
प्रातर्नमामि जगतां जननीमशेष-
लोकाधिनाथगृहिणीममृताब्धिपुत्रीम् ॥ १९ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Bathed in the pure waters of the celestial Ganga poured from golden jars held by guardian elephants of the quarters, at dawn I bow down to the Mother of all worlds, queen of the Sovereign of the universe, daughter of the ocean of immortality!

records.original_source_text:
कमले कमलावताक्षकान्ते
करुणापूरतरङ्गितैरपाङ्गैः ।
अवलोकय मामकिञ्चनानां
प्रथमं भक्तिमभक्तिहीननेत्रे ॥ २० ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: O Kamala! Beloved of the broad lotus-eyed Lord! With sidelong glances undulating like waves in an ocean of boundless compassion, look upon me, foremost among the destitute, O Mother whose eyes beam on sincere devotion!

records.original_source_text:
स्तुवन्ति ये स्तुतिभिरमीभिरन्वहं
त्रयीमयीं त्रिभुवनमातरं रमाम् ।
गुणाधिका गुरुतरभाग्यभागिनो
भवन्ति ते भुवि बुधभाविताशयाः ॥ २१ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Those who daily praise Rama (Lakshmi), the embodiment of the three Vedas, the Mother of the three worlds, with these hymns of praise — they become endowed with noble virtues, inherit immense fortune, and are honored by the wise across the earth!

records.original_source_text:
अयि गिरिनन्दिनि नन्दितमेदिनि विश्वविनोदिनि नन्दिनुते
गिरिवरविन्ध्यशिरोऽधिनिवासिनि विष्णुविलासिनि जिष्णुनुते ।
भगवति हे शितिकण्ठकुटुम्बिनि भूरिकुटुम्बिनि भूरिकृते
जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ १ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: O Daughter of the Mountain, who gladdens the earth, rejoices the cosmos, praised by Nandi! Dwelling on the crest of the magnificent Vindhya mountains, joy of Vishnu, praised by Indra! O Goddess, consort of the blue-throated Shiva, mother of the vast universe, creator of abundance! Victory to You, O Slayer of Mahishasura, with captivating braided hair, O daughter of the Mountain!
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Devi Mahatmya / Shakta Stotra Samgraha

records.original_source_text:
सुरवरवर्षिणि दुर्धरधर्षिणि दुर्मुखमर्षिणि हर्षरते
त्रिभुवनपोषिणि शङ्करतोषिणि किल्बिषमोषिणि घोषरते ।
दनुजशोषिणी दुर्मदशोषिणि किल्बिषदोषिणि दानवरते
जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ २ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Bestowing divine boons upon the celestials, overpowering the unvanquished, subduing the arrogant Durmukha demon, delighting in blissful joy! Nourishing the three worlds, pleasing to Shankara, erasing all sins! Victory to You, O Slayer of Mahishasura!
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Devi Mahatmya / Shakta Stotra Samgraha

records.original_source_text:
अयि जगदम्ब मदम्ब कदम्बवनप्रियवासिनि हासरते
शिखरिशिरोमणि तुङ्गहिमालयशृङ्गनिजालयमध्यगते ।
मधुमधुरे मधुकैटभगञ्जिनि कैटभभञ्जिनि रासरते
जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ ३ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: O Mother of the universe, my own mother, fond of dwelling in the fragrant Kadamba groves, rejoicing in smiles! Residing atop the lofty Himalayan peaks, crushing the demons Madhu and Kaitabha! Victory to You, O Slayer of Mahishasura!
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Devi Mahatmya / Shakta Stotra Samgraha

records.original_source_text:
अयि शतखण्डविखण्डितरुण्डवितुण्डितशुण्डगजाधिपते
रिपुगजगण्डविदारणचण्डपराक्रमशुण्डमृगाधिपते ।
निजभुजदण्डनिपातितखण्डविपातितमुण्डभटाधिपते
जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ ४ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Severing into a hundred pieces the torsos and trunks of the ferocious battle-elephants, mounted upon the lion whose fierce might tears through enemy beasts, crushing demon warriors with Your powerful arms! Victory to You, O Slayer of Mahishasura!
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Devi Mahatmya / Shakta Stotra Samgraha

records.original_source_text:
अयि रणदुर्मदशत्रुवधोदितदुर्धरनिर्जरशक्तिभृते
चतुरविचारधुरीणमहाशिवदूतकृतप्रमथाधिपते ।
दुरितदुरीहदुराशयदुर्मतिदानवदूतकृतान्तगते
जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ ५ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Manifesting the irresistible collective energy of the celestials to destroy battle-crazed demons, commissioning Shiva Himself as emissary to the arrogant asura hosts, bringing destruction upon wicked messengers! Victory to You, O Slayer of Mahishasura!
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Devi Mahatmya / Shakta Stotra Samgraha

records.original_source_text:
अयि शरणागतवैरिवधूवदनार्चितचाटुवदान्यविधे
विदुषवरार्चितपद्मपदाखिलविश्वपते दितिजार्तिहरे ।
अविचलभक्तिकृपालुजनेष्वभयप्रदहस्तसरोरुहभाक्
जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ ६ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Bestowing mercy even upon the pleading wives of surrendering enemies, whose lotus feet are revered by great sages, dispelling the afflictions of creation, extending the lotus hand of fearlessness to steady devotees! Victory to You, O Slayer of Mahishasura!
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Devi Mahatmya / Shakta Stotra Samgraha

records.original_source_text:
अयि निजहुङ्कृतमात्रनिराकृतधूम्रविलोचनधूम्रशते
समरविशोषितशोणितबीजसमुद्भवबीजलताविकृते ।
शिवशिवशुम्भनिशुम्भमहाहवतर्पितभूतपिशाचरते
जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ ७ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Destroying the demon Dhumralochana with a solitary roar of Hum, drinking the blood of Raktabija so no demon seeds could multiply, delighting the celestial spirits in the destruction of Shumbha and Nishumbha! Victory to You, O Slayer of Mahishasura!
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Devi Mahatmya / Shakta Stotra Samgraha

records.original_source_text:
धनुरनुषङ्गविमुक्तशरोत्कलिकीर्णहरोपहताङ्गगते
सरलविचित्रसुवर्णविचित्रविचित्रबभ्रुविचित्ररते ।
अमृतरसप्रसृतावयवे मदिरेक्षणविह्वलभक्तहृते
जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ ८ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Unleashing showers of arrows from Your celestial bow, radiant in dazzling golden ornaments of intricate design, whose divine limbs overflow with nectar, enchanting the hearts of ardent devotees! Victory to You, O Slayer of Mahishasura!
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Devi Mahatmya / Shakta Stotra Samgraha

records.original_source_text:
सुरललनाततथेयितथेयितथाभिनयोत्तरनृत्यरते
हासविलाससमाकुलमानसमङ्गलगानसुगीतरते ।
क्वणितासुपूरविचित्रकङ्कणकूजितनूपुरनादरते
जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ ९ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Rejoicing in the dramatic rhythmic dancing of celestial maidens to rhythmic beats, delighting in auspicious songs of victory, adorned with chiming bangles and tinkling anklets! Victory to You, O Slayer of Mahishasura!
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Devi Mahatmya / Shakta Stotra Samgraha

records.original_source_text:
अयि सुमनःसुमनःसुमनःसुमनःसुमनोहरकान्तियुते
श्रितरजनीरजनीरजनीरजनीरजनीकरवक्त्रवृते ।
सुनयनविभ्रमरभ्रमरभ्रमरभ्रमरभ्रमराधिपते
जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ १० ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Endowed with mesmerizing grace resembling the sweetest blossoms, face glowing like the tranquil moon, eyes fluttering with charming glances like black honeybees circling a lotus! Victory to You, O Slayer of Mahishasura!
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Devi Mahatmya / Shakta Stotra Samgraha

records.original_source_text:
सहितमहाहवमल्लमतल्लिकमल्लितरल्लकभल्लरते
विरचितवल्लिकपल्लिकमल्लिकझिल्लिकभिल्लिकवर्गवृते ।
शितकृतफुल्लसमुल्लसितारुणतल्लजपल्लवपादयुगे
जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ ११ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Wielding spears and arrows against the formidable champion wrestlers of the demon army, worshipped by simple forest tribes, whose lotus feet glow rosy-red like freshly sprouted tender leaves! Victory to You, O Slayer of Mahishasura!
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Devi Mahatmya / Shakta Stotra Samgraha

records.original_source_text:
अविरलगण्डगलन्मदमेदुरमत्तमत्तङ्गजराजपते
त्रिभुवनभूषणभूतकलानिधिरूपपयोनिधिराजसुते ।
अयि सुदतीजनलालसमानसमोहनमन्मथराजसुते
जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ १२ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Subduing raging war-elephants intoxicated with rut, daughter of the King of the Ocean, ornament of the three worlds, captivating the hearts of the noble and wise! Victory to You, O Slayer of Mahishasura!
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Devi Mahatmya / Shakta Stotra Samgraha

records.original_source_text:
कमलदलामलकोमलगानकलामलिकामलभाललते
सकलविलासमहानिधिशैलसुतावरचारुकटाक्षनुते ।
भ्रमरगणैरभिनन्दितचन्दनसौरभसौरभमन्दगते
जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ १३ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Forehead radiant and smooth like a lotus petal, ocean of all grace, whose graceful sidelong glances bestow boons, moving with majestic slow steps fragrant with sandalwood adored by bees! Victory to You, O Slayer of Mahishasura!
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Devi Mahatmya / Shakta Stotra Samgraha

records.original_source_text:
करमुरलीरवकूजितकूजितकोकिलमञ्जुलमञ्जुमते
मिलितपुलिन्दमनोहरगुञ्जितरञ्जितशैलनिकुञ्जगते ।
निजगुणभूतपवित्रितविश्वमनोहरनन्दनकाननभाक्
जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ १४ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Mind attuned to the sweet notes of the flute and the song of the cuckoo, gracing mountain bowers resonant with honeyed hums, purifying all worlds by Your virtues! Victory to You, O Slayer of Mahishasura!
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Devi Mahatmya / Shakta Stotra Samgraha

records.original_source_text:
कटितटपीतदुकूलविचित्रमयूखतिरस्कृतचन्द्ररुचे
प्रणतसुरासुरमौलिविरञ्जितरत्नकदम्बकराजिनुते ।
उदितमहारुणमण्डलनिर्मलकान्तिविलासविदीप्ततले
जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ १५ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Adorned around the waist with golden-yellow silk outshining the moon, whose feet are bathed in the multicolored gem-light of bowing gods and demons, shining like the newly risen sun! Victory to You, O Slayer of Mahishasura!
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Devi Mahatmya / Shakta Stotra Samgraha

records.original_source_text:
सुरनरवन्दितपादसरोरुहमुद्रितसर्वशुभप्रपते
कुमुदविकाससुहासविलाससुशोभितदिव्यमुखाम्बुरुहे ।
शिशिरशिलातलवासितपुष्पपरागसुगन्धितचन्द्रसुते
जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ १६ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Whose lotus feet, worshipped by gods and humans, impress auspiciousness upon all creation, whose face blossoms with a smile like night-blooming water lilies, fragrant with mountain wildflowers! Victory to You, O Slayer of Mahishasura!
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Devi Mahatmya / Shakta Stotra Samgraha

records.original_source_text:
अयि मयि दीनदयालुदयानिकुरुम्बकमेदुरनेत्ररुचे
निजपदकञ्जसमाश्रितदीनसुभक्तजनार्तिहरप्रभवे ।
कुरु दयया मयि दासममन्दमपारभवार्णवतारणतः
जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ १७ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: O Merciful Mother! Cast Your gaze overflowing with kindness upon me, Your humble servant, dispelling all suffering and ferrying me safely across the fathomless ocean of worldly existence! Victory to You, O Slayer of Mahishasura!
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Devi Mahatmya / Shakta Stotra Samgraha

records.original_source_text:
पदकमलं करुणानिलये वरिवस्यति योऽनुदिनं स शिवे
स कथं न भवेत्स कथं न भवेत्तव भावनया शुचिमानजनः ।
तव विमलेन्दुकुलं वदनं विचिन्तयतो हृदये ननु किम्
जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ १८ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Whoever daily serves Your lotus feet, O abode of compassion, O Auspicious Shivaa — how could that person not become purified and exalted through Your contemplation? Victory to You, O Slayer of Mahishasura!
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Devi Mahatmya / Shakta Stotra Samgraha

records.original_source_text:
स्तुतिभिरमन्दमुदारगुणाभिरुदीरितदिव्यगुणाम्बुनिधे
भजति यतो दयया स नरः समवाप्नुत एव परां मुदितम् ।
जननि तवैव पदाब्जपरागसुगन्धिनिवेशितमानसतो
जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ १९ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Whoever praises Your divine virtues through these exalted hymns, anchoring their mind upon the fragrant dust of Your lotus feet, attains supreme bliss and liberation! Victory to You, O Slayer of Mahishasura!
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Devi Mahatmya / Shakta Stotra Samgraha

records.original_source_text:
कनकप्रभावरनिर्मलकान्तिविराजितदिव्यशरीरधरे
कमलासनविष्णुमहेशसुरेश्वरवन्दितपादयुगे ।
परमशुभप्रदचित्तविभावनतारकपुण्यकृते सुखदे
जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ २० ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Dazzling with a golden aura of transcendental beauty, whose feet are revered by Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva, and Indra, granting highest peace, salvation, and joy to pure hearts! Victory to You, O Slayer of Mahishasura!
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Devi Mahatmya / Shakta Stotra Samgraha

records.original_source_text:
कनकल्सत्कलसिन्धुजलैरनुषिञ्चिनु ते गुणरङ्गभुवम्
भजति स किं न शचीकुचकुम्भतटीपरिरम्भसुखानुरतम् ।
तव चरणं शरणं करवाणि नतामरवाणि निवासि शिवे
जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ २१ ॥
records.existing_bhavartha: Whoever bathes Your sanctum with golden waters and worships You with pure devotion attains all celestial glory and divine peace. O Auspicious Mother, refuge of the gods, I surrender unto Your sacred lotus feet! Victory to You, O Slayer of Mahishasura!
supporting_source_references: Scripture: Devi Mahatmya / Shakta Stotra Samgraha
